jobs.title: Product Manager - Investing (f/m/x)
jobs.description:
About lemon.markets 🍋

We enable anyone to be an investor. Our mission is to grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses. By empowering FinTechs, banks, and wealth managers to offer investment products, we help create financial well-being for their customers.

lemon.markets is a Brokerage-as-a-Service platform: simple digital access to capital markets through a single API. Our API-first infrastructure abstracts brokerage complexity with a well-documented API, a self-service customer operations portal, and a clear regulatory framework, so partners can launch customer-centric, compliant products in weeks, not months.

As part of the dwpbank Group, we share a clear goal: we enable anyone to be an investor by making investing in capital markets more accessible. By combining dwpbank’s long-standing expertise and stability with lemon.markets’ technology-first mindset and speed, we are building a modern, modular securities services ecosystem. Together, we offer faster time-to-market, modular services, and a modern customer experience that helps financial service providers stay competitive and respond more flexibly in a changing market.

Your Mission

As a Product Manager in the Investing domain, you will contribute to the product scope our largest partners depend on, as well as our side of the joint dwpbank x lemon.markets suite. Your remit will include working with some of the biggest financial institutions in Europe to deliver core capabilities. These include trading mechanics, tax, corporate actions, and the investing capabilities we're building jointly with dwpbank. You will scope them, prioritise them, and deliver them.

Reporting to the Senior Product Manager, Investing, you'll drive complex, multi-stakeholder commitments end-to-end. You'll work across internal teams at lemon.markets, our largest partners, and dwpbank counterparts in the group. Success looks like partners shipping compliant products on our infrastructure without us being the bottleneck.

In this role you will:

  • Own the roadmap for a set of partner-critical Investing capabilities, from problem framing through to launch, adoption, and iteration.

  • Be embedded in a cross-functional crew including operations and engineering, while engaging with other product teams, solutions engineering, external partners, and colleagues in risk, finance, and compliance.

  • Prioritise commitments against the domain strategy using quantitative and qualitative evidence, and share your trade-offs internally and externally.

  • Ensure that any partner-specific integrations have longevity within our platform.

  • Engage directly with enterprise partners and prospects - scope requirements, negotiate delivery, prioritise.

  • Work with dwpbank counterparts on joint product opportunities, translating between two organisations with different ways of working.

  • Propose forward-looking solutions that outlive the immediate ask, rather than one-off fixes for the loudest partner.

  • Track market and regulatory developments in our space, and bring the insights back to the team.

You’ll be successful in this role if:

  • You have at least 2-3 years of product experience, independently shipping highly complex products.

  • You are comfortable with ambiguity - you can define a problem space, structure it, and move forward without waiting for someone else to hand you a spec.

  • You argue your position based on data and evidence, and iterate when the evidence changes.

  • You can express yourself in writing. Documentation, decisions, specs, partner comms - clear writing is a core part of the job.

  • You use AI tools in your day-to-day work and are comfortable pushing what they can do.

  • You are professionally fluent in English and German.

  • Experience in regulated fintech / brokerage or B2B environments is a plus!

How we take care of you:

  • 🚀 Compensation package: We offer you a competitive salary, based on your experience and the value-add you bring to lemon.markets.

  • 🕑 Flexible working hours: We trust people to choose when they work best and avoid a rigid 9 to 5 mindset. You decide on the rhythm that helps you do your best work, with only shared core hours from 12:00 to 16:00 to support collaboration.

  • 🏢 Hybrid work setup: You can work from anywhere in Germany within a hybrid model. At the same time, in-person collaboration is a key part of our culture. That being said, individual contributor lemoneers work 4 or more days per month on-site in our Berlin office, spending quality time together with the team at events, onsites/offsites or over team dinners.

  • 📈 Grow with us: We take your personal development seriously! You’ll get regular mentorship and stretch opportunities, a clear career development framework with frequent feedback conversations as well as an annual learning budget.

  • 🌱 People & culture: You’ll feel our culture in the small things, like Polaroids from our lemoneers’ first day and our monthly new-joiner breakfasts. But also in the bigger things, like celebrating the onboarding of new partners or our annual offsites, where the whole company comes together to connect, reflect, and celebrate.

  • 💛 Perks & benefits: We choose benefits that add actual value. We sponsor a Deutschlandticket for employees on unlimited contracts, plus 50% off on Beatvest - our partner for financial education and investing.

  • 🏝 Workation: Get out of here! At lemon.markets you can work remotely from anywhere in the EU for up to 10 consecutive days at a time, and up to 60 days per year in total.

jobs.title: Technical Product Lead (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. With our core product Playtime Arcade, we've become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in-app rewards for engaging with new apps. The result is one of the most effective value exchanges in adtech, connecting advertisers and publishers with over 770 million users annually.

Running the Engine Behind 200M+ Daily Ad Decisions

Behind every ad decision at adjoe is a system designed to operate at massive scale, serving more than 770 million mobile users every year. The Demand API Integrations team owns the systems that connect our platform to the global adtech ecosystem, handling over 5.5 billion API requests daily across installs, events, views, clicks, and postbacks from Mobile Measurement Partners.
We operate a dedicated A/B testing environment against live traffic to validate system behavior under real-world conditions, allowing us to evaluate advertiser integrations, benchmark partner performance, and verify attribution accuracy end-to-end before deploying globally.

We integrate TensorFlow-based ML models to predict user engagement and purchase likelihood, directly influencing real-time ad distribution. To meet our strict 100ms latency constraint, we prioritize efficient model serving, low-latency data access, and deliberate system design.

Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For

  • High-Scale Backend Product Leadership: You will own the roadmap and backlog for the campaign distribution engine that serves over 200 million daily mobile users, balancing rapid business feature requests with long-term platform integrity. We are looking for someone with 5+ years of experience as a Product Lead (preferably in B2B SaaS) managing backend-heavy, high-load systems who can navigate ambiguity and drive product delivery end-to-end.

  • Technical & Data Fluency: You will partner daily with software engineers, BI analysts, and data scientists to translate business objectives into functional requirements, assess feasibility, and leverage ML models for campaign optimization. You understand APIs and database architectures (like Druid) well enough to evaluate technical trade-offs, debate implementation details directly with engineers, and translate complex mechanics for commercial stakeholders.

  • Hypothesis-Driven Experimentation: You will maximize publisher revenue and campaign matching efficiency by validating product hypotheses before spending engineering capacity. We need a product leader who systematically defines success metrics, runs and evaluates A/B tests, and uses quantitative performance data to either iterate on winning logic or cut underperforming initiatives early.

  • People Management & Team Growth: You will lead the Demand Integrations product function, running regular 1-on-1s, driving career planning, and hiring new talent to scale the team. We are looking for an experienced people manager who mentors team members in product thinking, delivery accountability, and commercial ownership.

  • Hands-On AI Prototyping: You will accelerate product discovery and requirements definition by building functional proof-of-concepts yourself rather than waiting on dev cycles. You must be fluent enough with modern AI tooling to independently build and demonstrate a working prototype of a feature.

  • Pluses (Technical & AdTech Background): Direct experience in the AdTech ecosystem or a formal technical background gives you a head start in understanding our external partner integrations, auction dynamics, and high-throughput data pipelines.

🌎 We welcome applications from talent worldwide and provide relocation support to Hamburg, Germany for those ready to join our team.

What’s in It for You?
At adjoe, we are not just managing campaigns, we're helping build the business engine behind one of the fastest-growing adtech platforms in mobile. We are proactively curious: we question status quo, think outside the box, connect the dots. The partnerships you close, the strategies you execute, and the markets you develop will directly shape how adjoe scales globally.

  • Go Big. Own commercial initiatives that move revenue and expand adjoe's market position.

  • Move Fast. Operate in a high-velocity environment where decisions are made quickly and impact is visible immediately.

  • Be Direct. Work in a culture where feedback is honest, collaboration is real, and politics are low.

  • Thrive Together. Grow alongside a diverse, global team of 250+ people from over 40 countries across 7 offices.

  • Have Fun. Celebrate wins, build lasting industry relationships, and bring your energy to a team that genuinely enjoys what they do.

We welcome applications from people who will contribute to the diversity of our company.

jobs.title: Product Manager – Cross-Border Payments & Digital Assets
jobs.description:
About us

ClearBank was built on the belief that banking infrastructure should enable progress, not slow it down. Our clients, from fintechs and digital asset businesses to banks and financial institutions, use our technology and APIs to power innovative banking and payment propositions.

But we wouldn’t be ClearBank without our people. They’re what powers our technology and the reason we love what we do every day. We’re a group of ambitious, curious people who aren’t afraid to challenge the status quo. We believe in fairness, autonomy and choice, empowering our people with the tools and opportunities to learn, grow and contribute to the success of ClearBank and our clients.

About you

You’ll be joining the Product team as a Product Manager – Cross-Border Payments & Digital Assets, reporting to the Head of Product, Cross-Border Payments and Foreign Exchange.

This is an exciting opportunity to help shape ClearBank’s next generation of international payments and digital asset propositions.

We’re looking for an experienced, hands-on Product Manager who can operate at the intersection of cross-border payments, banking infrastructure and digital assets. You’ll help develop propositions that enable our clients to move money internationally through both traditional payment infrastructure and emerging digital asset and stablecoin rails.

You’ll be comfortable taking complex opportunities from discovery through to launch, working across Product, Engineering, Operations, Treasury, Financial Crime, Compliance, Risk and Commercial teams.

You’ll combine strong customer understanding with commercial and technical thinking, translating market opportunities and complex payment flows into scalable products that solve genuine customer problems.

You will be

As Product Manager, you’ll own key initiatives across cross-border payments and digital assets, helping define the product strategy, roadmap and delivery priorities.

You’ll work closely with Engineering and cross-functional teams to understand customer problems, define requirements and take new capabilities from discovery and design through delivery, pilot and commercial launch.

Within cross-border payments, this could include capabilities covering international payment corridors, payment providers and networks, multi-currency payment flows, FX-enabled payments and alternative payment rails.

Within Digital Assets, the role will contribute to developing propositions including stablecoin payments, stablecoin minting and redemption, fiat-to-digital-asset connectivity, custody and tokenisation opportunities

A major part of the role will be connecting these two worlds and exploring how emerging digital asset infrastructure can complement traditional correspondent banking and payment networks to deliver faster, more efficient and scalable global payment propositions.

You’ll also work directly with customers, partners and internal stakeholders to validate propositions and ensure they are commercially viable, operationally scalable and aligned with ClearBank’s risk and regulatory requirements.

Principal Duties and Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute product roadmaps in partnership with the Head of Product, translating strategic objectives into clear priorities and measurable outcomes.

  • Own product initiatives across the full lifecycle, from customer discovery and business case development through design, delivery, pilot, launch and ongoing optimisation.

  • Develop and enhance ClearBank’s cross-border payment propositions, including international payment corridors, payment providers, payment networks and new payment rails.

  • Help develop ClearBank’s Digital Assets proposition, including stablecoin payments, minting and redemption, fiat/stablecoin interoperability, custody and tokenisation-related opportunities.

  • Evaluate how traditional correspondent banking, payment networks and blockchain-based rails can be used individually or together to improve international payment propositions.

  • Work closely with Engineering, Architecture and Business Analysis teams to translate customer and business problems into clearly defined product and technology requirements.

  • Lead product discovery with existing and prospective clients to understand customer pain points, underlying use cases and future requirements.

  • Evaluate potential banking, payment and digital asset partners, considering product capability, coverage, commercial model, technology integration and customer proposition.

  • Build business cases and support product-level commercial management, including pricing, volumes, costs, revenue opportunities and product economics.

  • Work closely with Treasury, Operations, Financial Crime, Compliance, Legal and Risk teams to ensure new propositions can operate safely and effectively within ClearBank’s risk appetite and regulatory obligations.

  • Develop appropriate operating models and ensure operational processes, controls and customer journeys are ready ahead of product launch.

Core Skills and Experience

  • Strong Product Management experience within payments, banking, fintech or financial infrastructure.

  • Good understanding of cross-border payments, including correspondent banking, international payment flows and the challenges associated with moving money across currencies and jurisdictions.

  • Experience taking complex financial products from discovery through delivery and launch.

  • Demonstrable experience working with Engineering teams in an Agile product environment.

  • Strong customer-discovery skills, with the ability to turn customer problems and use cases into clear product requirements and priorities.

  • Strong commercial mindset, with experience considering pricing, costs, volumes, unit economics and business cases when making product decisions.

  • Ability to understand complex end-to-end payment flows and translate them into clear product, technical and operational requirements.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure ambiguous problems and recommend pragmatic solutions.

  • Experience working across multidisciplinary teams including Engineering, Operations, Compliance, Financial Crime, Treasury, Risk and Commercial functions.

  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to explain complex payment or technology concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • A proactive, hands-on approach with strong ownership and accountability.

A little bit more about us! 

ClearBank is Where You Can belong: 

At ClearBank we think about Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DE&I) a lot. Not because we think we should. But because we know we should – how else can we build a happy workforce and be successful as a business. We’re committed to making sure our teams reflect society. And we put energy and effort into making this a place where everyone feels at home, where they’re given the trust and encouragement to do their very best work. Here are some of the things we’re most proud of: 

  • 42% of our senior management roles are held by women 

  • Our enhanced family leave policies

  • Launching our partnership with Code First Girls 

  • Increasing awareness of neurodiversity in the workplace through our partnership with the Inclusive Group 

Our hiring process and what you can expect:

Application: a member of our talent acquisition team will review your application against the key requirements for the role and let you know within two weeks whether you’re moving forward to the next stage; 

Screening: You’ll spend 30-45 minutes speaking to one of our recruiters learning more about the role and ClearBank, and we’ll get it know more about you, your experience and how your skills align with the role (this will be via phone or Teams video call). You can expect to hear back from us within seven days following this meeting (if things are taking longer than expected, we’ll let you know that too); 

First Interview: You’ll spend one hour with a member of our hiring team focusing on your skills, competencies and your ways of working at the same time we’ll give you time to ask more questions about the role, the team and learn more about the ClearBank culture. This will be via Teams.  

Second Interview: This will be a competency-based interview with one or more members of our team.

Final Stage: You will have a final meeting with the Head of Department. This will be around 45-60 minutes.  

Offer: Congratulations! Get ready to transform banking forever! 

 

Our commitment to you as a candidate: 

We will always try our best to get back to you within seven days of your interview whether you’ve been successful or not and provide you with feedback. Sometimes things take a little longer, so we may not have a decision to share but we will get it touch to let you know we need a little more time.  

We’re unable to provide specific individual feedback at the application or screening stage but know that your application was reviewed and considered carefully.  

We wish you the best of luck with your application and maybe we’ll be celebrating your new role at ClearBank soon!  

Equal Opportunities

ClearBank is committed to ensuring equal opportunities throughout every stage of the recruitment process. ClearBank recognises that diversity is vital to the long-term success of the business in the communities and markets in which it operates. ClearBank is also a firm believer that an inclusive culture fosters greater employee engagement and collaboration. 

ClearBank strives for diversity and inclusion of all forms, including (but not limited to): gender, age, educational and professional background, disability, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief and sexual orientation. 

As part of the Company’s commitment to equal employment opportunity, we provide reasonable adjustments, to candidates during the recruitment process, including to individuals with disabilities. We want to create a safe space that welcomes everyone so please let us know how we can accommodate you. In case you have any accessibility requirements you can share that with our Talent Acquisition team prior to your interview stage, if applicable. 

The legal bit

By submitting your CV to ClearBank Limited you are providing your consent for us to use the information you provide for recruitment purposes. For more information on how we manage your data go and check out our Candidate Privacy Notice on the ClearBank website to see how we process, manage and look after your data. You are also allowing us to communicate with you by email and telephone for recruitment purposes.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Senior HR Project Manager to join our HR Transformation team, based in our Leeds office. In this brand-new role, you will play a critical part in helping us mature our people function and drive key strategic initiatives across LeoVegas Group. Reporting directly to the Director of HR Transformation, you will take ownership of high-impact people and workforce projects, and cross-functional HR frameworks.

As a dedicated project lead, you will act as a vital bridge connecting different HR disciplines—including Talent Acquisition, Reward, L&D, and People Operations—with C-suite execs and senior business leaders. You will bring robust project discipline, clear governance, and commercial acumen to make sure our transformation initiatives run smoothly, stay on track, and deliver real value to the wider business. This is a fantastic opportunity for a structured project professional with a strong HR background to help deliver our global HR projects in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR:

  • Leading end-to-end HR transformation projects.

  • Establishing clear project management structures, timelines, risk management, and reporting via project management tools.

  • Building strong relationships and comfortably managing senior stakeholders, including Directors and C-suite members.

  • Connecting different HR functions to ensure cross-team alignment, smooth communication, and clear project visibility.

  • Driving commercial HR conversations and guiding business leaders through operational change and maturity initiatives.

  • Escalating risks, removing blockers, and keeping complex short- and long-term project deliverables on track.

OUR SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE THE FOLLOWING:


ESSENTIAL SKILLS

  • A minimum of 5+ years of experience as a Project Manager, with a strong background in or deep working knowledge of HR functions.

  • Demonstrated ability to build trust and influence senior stakeholders, with the credibility to command the room.

  • Exceptional communication, emotional intelligence, and conflict management skills when navigating complex change.

  • Strong commercial acumen and a structured, pragmatic approach to delivering business-aligned outcomes.

  • Experience working in a mature, fast-paced corporate environment (preferably across international locations).

NICE TO HAVES

  • Exposure to AI transformation projects or leveraging modern AI tools within HR workflows.

  • Familiarity with project management software such as Monday.com, Smartsheet, or MS Project.

jobs.title: Senior / Staff Product Manager
jobs.description:
V7

At V7, we’re building AI platforms that help humans do their best work, at incredible scale and speed. Our mission is to turn human knowledge into trustworthy AI, making complex tasks faster, smarter, and more accurate. We’re growing fast, backed by leading investors and AI pioneers (including the minds behind Transformers and Gemini).

The product

V7 Go helps teams turn complex, repeatable work into AI workflows they can run, review and improve. Built for private markets, insurance and real estate, it supports investment diligence, underwriting, claims review and portfolio reporting—from analysing documents and data to generating deliverables and updating connected systems.

Your experts define how the work should be done. V7 combines reusable Skills, shared company knowledge and configurable workflows, with citations, audit logs and human review to help teams verify results and control key decisions. It supports models including GPT, Claude and Gemini.

  • Build workflows around your processes. Configure each stage, choose models and tools, and set review steps where human judgement matters. Teams can inspect sources, correct outputs and refine workflows over time. Explore workflows.

  • Give every workflow your firm’s knowledge. The Context Graph connects documents, entities, relationships and source evidence, creating institutional memory that teams and agents can draw on.

  • Turn analysis into work your team can use. Generate editable memos, reports, presentations and spreadsheets, and connect workflows to the tools your business already uses. Explore document generation.

Have a look at what we’re building for finance and insurance.

The team you’ll be joining and the impact you’ll have

  • You’ll own V7 Go. That’s the whole product, not a corner of it, working with engineers, designers and with the founders close by.

  • Go 4x-ed revenue last year with 160%+ upsell, and we’re running tens of millions of documents through it for customers in finance, insurance and real estate. What you choose to build next is what decides where that goes.

  • The product does a lot of different things for a lot of different teams. A big part of the job is having a view on what it should be, and being willing to say no to the rest.

  • It’s a small product team, so there’s not much process to hide behind. If something’s broken or missing, it’s yours to sort out.

What you’ll be doing from day one

  • Owning the roadmap. Deciding what gets built, killing the stuff that doesn’t matter, and shipping continuously rather than in quarterly chunks.

  • Working out which problems are actually worth solving. Sales wants one thing, the loudest customer wants another, and the interesting bet is usually neither.

  • Defining what good looks like before anything gets built, then checking afterwards whether it landed. Adoption, not shipped tickets.

  • Making the trade-off calls. What’s in, what’s out, what’s deliberately a bit rubbish for now, and being able to explain why to whoever asks.

  • Writing things down clearly. Decisions, trade-offs, why we said no to something. It’s how a small team stays pointed the same way.

  • Keeping the whole thing coherent. Workflows, Context Graph and chat need to feel like one product rather than three that happen to share a login. Most of the features are self-serve, so if it needs explaining, that's a product problem.

Who you are

  • You’ve owned a product properly, at a startup or somewhere with a serious product culture. Not running a backlog someone else set.

  • You've owned a real product area end to end at a startup or a company with a serious product culture. Discovery through launch, not backlog management.

  • You've built for expert users who know their domain better than you do. B2B SaaS, fintech, insurtech, developer tools, data platforms.

  • You're genuinely hands-on with LLMs and agents. You build with them, you have views on what they're good and bad at, and you can tell a demo from a product.

  • You can hold a conversation with engineers about trade-offs without needing everything translated.

  • You’re happy without much certainty. Priorities move here more than they would somewhere bigger.

  • Opinionated but not precious about it.

V7 champions equality and inclusion because diverse teams build better products. Don't check every box? Apply anyway — we value what makes you unique and will support you through the process, just let our Talent team know how they can help.

Compensation: £100K – £140K • Offers Equity

jobs.title: Product Owner Gemeentepas
jobs.description:
Wil jij maximale waarde creëren voor gemeenten, aanbieders en eindgebruikers met de Gemeentepas? Het kan als Product Owner. Je vormt de spil tussen business, technologie en operatie en is in staat om de strategische doelen van de organisiatie te vertalen naar tactische doelen en het opzetten van een duidelijke productvisie, roadmap en backlog.

Wat jij doet

Als Product Owner ontwikkel en onderhoud je een heldere productvisie en -strategie voor de stadspasoplossing, afgestemd op de behoeften van gemeenten en het portfolio van Centric. Je richt je op het bepalen van de productrichting, het vertalen van wensen en behoeften naar concrete verbeteringen en het onderhouden van sterke relaties met stakeholders.

In deze rol gaan we een maximaal beroep doen op je commerciële vaardigheden. De Gemeentepas is een nieuwe oplossing binnen ons portfolio. Dat betekent dat je veel contact met potentiële klanten zult hebben. Hun wensen weet te vertalen naar standaardoplossingen en daarvoor een marktconforme vergoeding weet te verantwoorden. Je zult actief in aanbesteding trajecten een inhoudelijk en commerciële rol gaan vervullen.

Je wordt daarin uiteraard ondersteund door onze product sales en productmanager. Wij denken dat dit een hele mooie kans is voor een zeer ondernemende product owner die in zichzelf en een nieuw product wil investeren.

Wat doe je nog meer?

  • Productstrategie en roadmap: Je stelt een roadmap op voor de doorontwikkeling van de Gemeentepas. Hierbij kijk je naar integraties met gemeentelijke systemen, waaronder Suites voor het Sociaal Domein, en onderzoek je nieuwe mogelijkheden, zoals koppelingen met Europese wallets.

  • Klant- en stakeholdermanagement: Je vertegenwoordigt de stem van de klant en zorgt ervoor dat wensen, behoeften en eisen van gemeenten, aanbieders en eindgebruikers worden vertaald naar concrete productverbeteringen.

  • Backlogbeheer en prioritering: Je beheert en prioriteert de productbacklog op basis van businesswaarde, wettelijke vereisten, strategische doelstellingen en gebruikersfeedback.

  • Samenwerking met het ontwikkelteam: Je werkt nauw samen met het scrumteam om epics en user stories op te stellen, te verfijnen en te valideren, zodat de ontwikkelwerkzaamheden aansluiten bij de productvisie.

  • Analyse en optimalisatie: Je identificeert hiaten in de functionaliteit door middel van fit-gapanalyses en initieert verbeteringen op het gebied van gebruikerservaring (UX), toegankelijkheid en systeemintegraties.

  • Markt- en trendontwikkeling: Je volgt marktontwikkelingen, relevante wet- en regelgeving en technologische innovaties en vertaalt deze naar nieuwe functionaliteiten en proposities.

  • Monitoring en waardecreatie: Je bewaakt de voortgang en de gerealiseerde waarde per sprint en release en stuurt waar nodig bij om de productdoelstellingen te behalen.

  • Rapportage en KPI’s: Je monitort en rapporteert over relevante KPI’s, zoals gebruikerstevredenheid en de adoptie van de stadspasoplossing door gemeenten en aanbieders

Dit krijg je

Bij Centric kun je als Product Owner/ Productmanager rekenen op:

  • Een brutosalaris van €4.500,- tot € 5.250,- per maand afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring

  • Mogelijkheid tot thuiswerken en een goede werk-privébalans doordat je de ruimte krijgt om te bepalen hoe jij jouw werkweek indeelt

  • Uitgebreide opleidings- en ontwikkelmogelijkheden

  • 26 vakantiedagen, 8% vakantietoeslag (uitbetaling in mei) en loyaliteitsdagen: hoe langer je in dienst bent, hoe meer vrije tijd

  • Een bijdrage aan je pensioen en korting op je collectieve zorgverzekering

  • Een laptop en telefoon van de zaak

  • Een thuiswerkplekvergoeding van € 15,- per maand plus € 2,45 netto per thuiswerkdag

  • Een mobiliteitsbudget omdat jij zelf wil bepalen hoe je van werk naar huis reist

  • Personeelsaanbiedingen bij toonaangevende merken

  • Een bonus tot € 1.500,- als jij een nieuwe collega aan ons voorstelt

  • Een personeelsvereniging die écht leuke dingen organiseert. Ga je mee naar Praag, de Efteling of skiën?

Dit breng je mee

Je hebt strategisch inzicht, bent besluitvaardig en beschikt over sterke analytische vaardigheden. Daarnaast herken je jezelf in het volgende profiel:

  • Je hebt hbo-werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in de richting van IT, bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbaar vakgebied.

  • Je hebt enkele jaren ervaring als Product Owner of Product Manager binnen softwareontwikkeling.

  • Je hebt ervaring binnen de publieke sector. Kennis van het Sociaal Domein is een sterke pré.

  • Je hebt kennis van systeemintegraties, security en privacy, waaronder de AVG en Secure Software Development.

Het maken van een assessment kan onderdeel uitmaken van deze sollicitatieprocedure.

Omring jezelf met mogelijkheden bij Centric


Hier starten jouw kansen  
Zonder dat je het misschien weet, ben je al eens met Centric in aanraking geweest. Als je betaalt in de winkel. Als je een glas kraanwater drinkt. Als je een paspoort aanvraagt. Duizenden organisaties en hun miljoenen klanten rekenen elke dag weer op onze 200+ technologische oplossingen, hoogwaardige IT-diensten en 3.700 gekwalificeerde professionals. Samen zorgen we dat belangrijke processen in onze samenleving altijd doordraaien. 

Zodra je Centric komt versterken, omring jij jezelf met mogelijkheden. Zo kun je jouw kennis vergroten door samen te werken met de ongeveer 500 collega’s van Digitale Overheid. Want wist jij dat bijna alles wat inwoners van Nederland met de overheid regelen via onze oplossingen verloopt? Denk aan lokale belastingen en vergunningen, maar ook aanvraag van reisdocumenten en een uitkeringsaanvraag. Hi, I'm Maria, Interim VP Product at FeedbackFruits. 👋

FeedbackFruits is moving from a founder-led company to a product-led one, which means Product is taking on a much bigger role in deciding what we build and why. Before stepping into this role I worked as a PM here myself, with the squads and within the details, so I know how much depends on the PMs who work with those squads every day. I'm building a team of PMs who care about the craft: who do the discovery before committing to a build, make clear calls about priorities, and follow their work through to how teachers end up using it.

I'm looking for a Product Manager to lead one of our squads and own how teachers go from setting up their first activity to making FeedbackFruits part of how they teach every week. That means helping instructors see which students are stuck while there's still time to step in, making grading faster and less painful, and making it easy for a great activity to travel from one teacher to the next across an institution. You'll decide what the squad works on and why, and you'll have the room to set that direction yourself.

The EdTech market is tough right now, so every product decision has to earn its place. I like working this way, because a PM with sharp judgment sees their impact fast. You’ll also help shape how product works here as we raise the bar together: how we find the right problems, make calls and bring people along, and what great looks like for the PMs who join after you.

What you'll do:

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap for your squad, and keep its work tied to what matters most to us right now: teachers getting value from FeedbackFruits early and coming back for more

  • Run discovery with teachers, institutions and partners, dig into the data, and frame each problem clearly before anyone starts designing a solution

  • Make the prioritisation calls, including the "not now"s, and explain them with enough context that people follow your reasoning even when they'd have chosen differently

  • Work side by side with engineers on technical approach and feasibility, and with designers on critiques and validating solutions with users

  • Keep Sales, Partner Success and leadership aligned by documenting decisions, presenting strategy and progress, and keeping the roadmap visible

Working with the Mammo product lead, QRC, and US teams, the Engineering Manager, Mammography ensures the right software reaches the right sites on time, with the quality a medical device requires. The role reports to the Software Engineering Manager, Clinical AI Devices.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead and mentor a team of 3 to 4 engineers; support their technical and professional growth.

  • Set clear goals, run regular 1:1s and performance reviews, and give constructive feedback.

  • Recruit, onboard and retain great engineers.

  • Foster a culture of ownership, quality and continuous improvement.

Release & Delivery Management (TDM)

  • Own the Mammo release plan jointly with the product lead: scope, sizing, milestones and monthly release tracking.

  • Drive each release end to end: planning, development, verification, regulatory sign-off, deployment and post-release follow-up.

  • Align the Mammo team's delivery practices, processes and tools with the Clinical AI standards.

  • Make sure test setups are ready so product can run functional validation on time.

Quality & Regulatory Compliance

  • Work with QRC on regulatory impact assessments for every change.

Cross-Functional & US Collaboration

  • Communicate status, risks and trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Coordinate with platform, AI and data teams on dependencies.

Technical Leadership

Take part in design and architecture reviews, challenge estimates and unblock the team.

Keep a strong grasp of the system without writing production code day to day.

PLEASE NOTE: This is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and requirements of the position described above. Other functions may be assigned and management retains the right to add or change duties at any time.

jobs.title: Unity Intern
jobs.description:
Join Our Team as a Unity Developer Intern at Beyond Sports!

Hi, I’m Leon, part of the team here at Beyond Sports, and I’d love to invite you to consider joining us as a Unity Developer Intern!

Beyond Sports is a visualization company that is changing the way the world experiences sports. We work with the biggest leagues and broadcasters in the world—including the NFL, NHL, NBA and more—to turn real match data into groundbreaking, real-time virtual experiences.

From creating the Inside Out Classic altcast with Disney Pixar to building live virtual worlds for fans, our work is at the forefront of sports technology. As part of Sony’s sports businesses, we’re a passionate, creative, and ambitious team based in Alkmaar—and we’re looking for the next generation of talent to join us.

If you’re passionate about Unity, real-time 3D, and want to see your work come to life on a global stage, this could be the perfect internship for you.

What Your Day Will Look Like

As a Unity Developer Intern, you’ll be a real part of the development team. You won’t be observing from the sidelines—you’ll actively contribute to projects that are experienced by millions of sports fans around the world.

Working closely with developers, artists, and producers, you’ll help bring data-driven sports experiences to life.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Developing, testing, and debugging real-time 3D applications using Unity and C#

  • Writing clean, efficient, and well-structured code together with the team

  • Assisting with integrating new features, from data processing to visual output

  • Participating in Agile/Scrum ceremonies such as stand-ups, sprint planning, and reviews

  • Collaborating with experienced developers and learning from their expertise

  • Contributing your own ideas to solve technical challenges and improve our products

What We Value

At Beyond Sports, we value curiosity, ownership, and a proactive mindset. You’ll thrive in this role if you:

  • Are eager to learn and continuously improve your technical skills

  • Enjoy solving complex problems and thinking analytically

  • Take initiative and feel ownership over your work

  • Have a strong eye for detail

  • Communicate clearly and enjoy working in a team environment

About You

  • Currently enrolled in (or recently graduated from) a Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Game Development, or a related field

  • Experience with Unity (Unity3D) and C#

  • Understanding of object-oriented programming (OOP) principles

  • Familiar with version control systems, preferably Git

  • Good communication skills in English

  • Available to work on-site in our Alkmaar office

Nice to have:

  • Affinity with sports (e.g. football, American football, ice hockey)

  • Experience with Agile/Scrum

  • Basic understanding of CI/CD pipelines

Why Start Your Career at Beyond Sports

You’ll be part of an international and energetic team where no day is the same. We work on cutting-edge technology, move fast, and make sure there’s always room for fun alongside hard work.

We also make sure it’s a great place to grow:

  • Daily lunch prepared by our in-house chef

  • Fresh fruit, snacks, and beverages

  • Friday drinks and regular team outings

  • A social and international work environment

  • The opportunity to work on products seen by millions worldwide

  • A chance to learn from experienced developers in a fast-growing tech company

Ready to Change the Game?

If you’re excited to combine your passion for technology and sports, we’d love to hear from you.

At Beyond Sports, you won’t just be learning—you’ll be building the future of sports experiences.

jobs.title: Lead Product Designer - Platform Experience - UK (Remote)
jobs.description:
**This role is based within the UK only and you need to have the Right To Work without Sponsorship to be considered**

A platform you can believe in: Immersive One is the leading cyber resilience solution across the globe.

Build and scale a best in class platform alongside a team of the brightest minds in cybersecurity! At Immersive, we’re uniquely positioned to future-proof organizations against any cyber challenge. If that excites you, read on!


Immersive is the cyber proving ground for the AI enterprise. Through Immersive One, organizations can test whether people, AI-enabled workflows, cyber security teams, agents, and leaders can perform securely under realistic pressure, then turn that performance into evidence they can use to improve, benchmark, and report readiness.

Trusted by 30%+ of the Fortune 100 and ranked #1 in the Forrester Wave™ 2026, Immersive helps organizations prove AI can be adopted safely, teams can develop and defend at AI speed, leaders can lead through crisis, and AI agents can be validated before they are trusted in live workflows

https://www.immersivelabs.com/why-immersive-labs

We help the world’s biggest brands like Citi, Pfizer, Humana, and HSBC, protect their revenues and brand reputations.

Immersive was founded in 2017, from a cargo container in Bristol, UK we’ve grown to over 300 employees globally, announced funding of more than $180 million and been voted a Best place to work on multiple occasions!

https://www.immersivelabs.com/company/our-story

Lead Product Designer -Platform Experience - UK (Remote)

We’re looking for experienced, customer-centric and data-driven individuals to join our Product team as a Lead Product Designer - Platform Experiences based out of the UK.

You will help shape a connected, intuitive platform that simplifies complex workflows and makes insights more actionable. This is an ideal role for someone who loves information architecture, systems thinking and creating seamless experiences across products.

Beyond the product, you'll help shape how we work as a design team, raising the quality of our thinking, craft and collaboration.

As an advocate for Product Design excellence within Immersive, you will shape the next generation of AI-powered and agentic experiences within our enterprise cybersecurity platform, Immersive One. You'll help design intelligent, trustworthy workflows that bring together human expertise, AI-assisted decision-making, and increasingly autonomous capabilities.


Reporting to the Director of Product Design, you’ll own product problems from early discovery and definition through to validation, detailed design, delivery and iteration. You’ll work closely with Product and Engineering, using research, data and strong product judgement to shape experiences that work for customers and the wider platform.


This is a role for someone who thinks beyond individual screens — considering end-to-end journeys, information architecture, workflows, reusable patterns and how decisions scale across a complex B2B product.


You will be instrumental in shaping the future of our products, designing flexible, intelligent frameworks rooted in object-oriented thinking and guided by customer and user feedback and research. Your product output will drive measurable business outcomes that shape the evolution of our design system to define how cyber resilience comes to life across the Immersive One platform.


Our most successful product designers here bring a potent mix of strategic vision, user empathy, and analytical rigor to their work, while constantly expanding their knowledge through cross-team collaboration. You are the sparring partner for the Product Managers and Engineering teams with a close eye for scalability and commerciality - a true consultant who brings both research and evidence to the table and is able to articulate the ‘Why’ to validate design decisions through experimentation, metrics, and real-world usage.

As the most senior individual contributor in the team, your main responsibilities will include:

  • Lead the design of thoughtful, high-quality and scalable product experiences, from defining the right approach through prototyping, validation and detailed design execution.

  • Pioneer the integration of intelligent automation and generative AI into user flows to dramatically boost efficiency, accuracy, and decision-making speed.

  • Transform complex, technical cybersecurity data into clear, intuitive user interfaces that facilitate effective investigation, analysis, and response.

  • Partner closely with research teams to synthesize qualitative and quantitative insights, grounding all design decisions in solid data.

  • Champion Object-Oriented UX (OOUX) to create reusable components and streamlined workflows aligned with core platform entities.

  • Govern the evolution of our design system to guarantee cross-product consistency, accessibility, and intelligent adaptability.

  • Leverage customer insights, behavioural analytics and success metrics to inform product priorities, guide design decisions and measure the real-world impact of our solutions.

  • Collaborate with engineering partners to ensure the thoughtful, consistent, and scalable implementation of all product features.

Sounds good? We’d love to hear from you if you have proven experience in the following areas, but don’t worry if you don’t hit each one exactly:

  • Extensive experience in product or UX design, particularly within complex SaaS enterprise, data-driven, and platform environments. Ideally, you have worked on AI-powered features, intelligent automation, agentic workflows, or AI-native products

  • Demonstrated track record designing for complex enterprise UX – ideally B2B SaaS, cybersecurity, developer tools, infrastructure, or technical platforms.

  • Experience shaping design direction across complex products, making informed design decisions, bringing others along and remaining hands-on in execution.

  • Exceptional collaboration skills to strategically partner with product, engineering, and research to align design outcomes with core business and user objectives.

  • Expertise in systems thinking, sophisticated interaction design, and establishing robust, data-connected workflows.

  • Comfortable using emerging AI tools and rapidly testing ideas with Product and Engineering.

  • Familiarity with or a strong interest in Object-Oriented UX (OOUX), advanced information architecture, and data modeling principles.

  • Ability to define, track, and analyze success metrics to measure the tangible impact and effectiveness of design solutions.

  • Excellent communication, presentation, and storytelling skills, with a proven ability to influence and align diverse, senior-level stakeholders

    We are looking for our Product Designer to be based in the UK, and we offer both remote and hybrid working options.

Immersive’s growth has been fuelled by our values that underpin everything we do, here's how they relate to this role:

  • Driven - We push the boundaries of innovation, acting swiftly to achieve ambitious outcomes. Our drive embodies a culture of ambition, where challenges are stepping stones to excellence.

  • Inclusive - Our strength lies in diversity, fostering a culture where every individual contributes to our collective strength. We champion open dialogue and empathy, ensuring a collaborative, inclusive workplace.

  • Customer Centric - We seek to develop deep relationships with our customers to help them achieve their business outcomes. We exceed our customers and partners' expectations by crafting products, services and experiences that surprise, delight and ensure they feel valued and supported every day.

  • One Team - We are a talented global team working together to achieve our vision. Central to our ethos, resilience means adapting and thriving in adversity. It guides our innovation, ensuring we and our clients are prepared for the future.

We encourage people of all different backgrounds and identities to apply. We are committed to maintaining an inclusive, supportive place for you to be you and do your very best work.

Excited by the above? We’re ready to receive your application!


As well as an inclusive, supportive place for you to be you. We offer an extensive range of benefits so you can do your very best work:

  • Time off, flexible and remote working so you can work when is best for you, includes 25 days annual leave + 2 volunteering days and birthday day off

  • Look after your family and yourself with enhanced parental leave, mindfulness groups, critical illness cover,

  • Career and learning development through the platform and our ‘Learn Anything’ fund

  • Share in the companies success with share options, sales incentives and Recognition & Rewards for doing great work and living our values and behaviours

  • Informal or formal flexible working options, e.g. flexible start and finish times, reduced hours, job share, remote working

  • We’re a sociable, tight-knit team with monthly socials, and sports clubs. Our socials have included everything from pottery painting and paper mask making, to movie nights and escape rooms

  • While this is a remote position, we do all meet in our EMEA HQ on a bi annual basis and regularly in person in region.

Find out more about life at Immersive Labs https://careers.immersivelabs.com

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
Finom is a fast-growing European tech startup, headquartered in Amsterdam, on a mission to revolutionize the financial landscape for entrepreneurs globally. We are developing an all-in-one financial B2B solution that seamlessly integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a mobile-first platform.
 
Following a significant €115 million Series C equity round, bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million, we are expanding aggressively across key EU markets (Germany, France, Netherlands, Italy, Spain). We go beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, to simplify financial management for small and medium-sized businesses.
 
At Finom, we empower our employees to make a real difference. We nurture an innovative and inspiring environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation, and ensuring every effort benefits our users, partners, and our business as a whole.
 
Engineering Manager - Product
 
We're looking for an Engineering Manager who's both a technical leader and a product builder. You'll guide a cross-functional team (5-10 engineers across backend, frontend, mobile, and QA) in delivering products that create real value for hundreds of thousands of businesses across Europe.

What You Will Be Doing
  • You're a seasoned technical leader with strong engineering roots and a track record of building teams that ship products that matter. You communicate clearly with everyone – engineers, product managers, executives – and you're genuinely curious about the product, the users, the business, and how your team's work drives real impact.
  • You don't just manage delivery. You challenge problem framing with your PM partner, ensure the team solves the right problems, and think in terms of business outcomes, not just technical outputs. You're comfortable discussing retention and conversion funnels alongside system architecture. You help the team understand ROI and prioritize based on value and effort.
  • You have deep technical expertise and can still step in to unblock when needed. You balance feature delivery with technical debt, keeping scalability in mind while ensuring the team ships at pace. You make technical decisions through explicit trade-offs, not gut feelings, and help everyone understand the "why" behind choices.
  • You take ownership of both outcomes and people. You run meaningful 1:1s, create growth plans, and own hiring and promotions. You build engaged teams through honest feedback and coaching. You invest in making the team more productive – better tools, smarter processes, fewer bottlenecks.
  • You drive predictable delivery by partnering tightly with Product and Design. You communicate proactively about priorities, risks, and constraints. You encourage healthy debate and move toward "disagree and commit" when needed.

    • Who You Are
  • 5+ years of software development building data-intensive production systems
  • Proven track record leading cross-functional engineering teams
  • Deep technical knowledge: hands-on experience with at least one of the common general-purpose languages and platforms (C#/.NET, Java/JVM, JavaScript/Node, Go), distributed architectures, databases, messaging and queueing systems.
  • Experience in product-led organizations, ideally with international scopeStrong business acumen – you connect engineering work to revenue, retention, and trust
  • Comfortable with product metrics (DAU/MAU, retention, conversion funnels)
  • Exceptional communication in English across all audiencesA builder's mentality: you care about shipping great products and growing great teams

    • Our tech stack

     

  • Backend: .NET Core, PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ, Kafka, Kubernetes

  • You'll lead teams using React, Swift/Kotlin, Python/ML frameworks, and modern QA tools

    • What You Will Get In Return
     
    Make a genuine impact on the product
     
    We're a growing fintech serving hundreds of thousands of European businesses. You'll lead a domain team with real ownership and autonomy over what you build and how you build it. This is a place for curious leaders who want to grow as technical managers, product thinkers, and people leaders.
     
    Work in the EU
     
    Embark on this exciting journey with us and enjoy the flexibility of traveling and working remotely or in a hybrid model across Europe.
     
    Become a stock options holder
     
    Unlock your inner entrepreneur and align your aspirations with ours through our Stock Options Program. This exciting opportunity is available to every team member, from junior team members to our founders.
     
    Receive unwavering support and care
     
    Finom stands by you at every step, embodying our commitment to your well-being and success reflected in our modern, friendly, and eco-conscious corporate culture. We offer constant support and care to ensure your Finom experience is successful and fulfilling.
     
    Work & Swim program
     
    Immerse yourself in our exclusive Work & Swim Program. Spend one month in a comfortable corporate apartment in enchanting Cyprus. It's the ideal opportunity to strike the perfect work-life balance while enjoying breathtaking Mediterranean views.
     
    Equal Opportunity Statement 
     
    At Finom, we're an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We embrace diversity and invite applications from all walks of life. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability status, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

jobs.description:
Über 4POS AG

4POS AG ist ein international tätiges Unternehmen im Bereich der Herstellung und Vermarktung von Kassenhardware. Dabei verkörpert 4POS Schweizer Qualität im Design und in der Entwicklung von Kassensystemen und anderen POS-Lösungen. Zur Unterstützung unseres Produktmanagements suchen wir jemanden mit einem ausgeprägten Interesse an IT-Hardware und Projektleitungsfähigkeiten.

Zur Unterstützung unseres Produktmanagement suchen wir jemanden mit einem ausgeprägtes Interesse an IT-Hardware und Projektleitungsfähigkeiten.

Ihre Aufgaben

In dieser Rolle verantworten Sie die Weiterentwicklung unseres Produktportfolios im Bereich Kassensysteme. Sie begleiten unsere Produkte über ihren gesamten Lebenszyklus und sorgst dafür, dass sie technisch, wirtschaftlich und marktseitig optimal aufgestellt sind.

  • Sie koordinieren die Einführung neuer Produkte sowie Änderungen und Verbesserungen bestehender Produkte.

  • Sie analysieren Markttrends und Wettbewerber und entwickelst daraus passende Produktstrategien.

  • Sie planen und koordinierst Produktabkündigungen und das Management von Obsoleszenzen.

  • Sie arbeiten eng mit Vertrieb, Projektleitung, Kunden und OEM-/ODM-Partnern zusammen und unterstützt bei Ausschreibungen.

  • Sie verantworten Produktdokumentationen, ERP-Stammdaten sowie die Einhaltung regulatorischer Anforderungen und Zertifizierungen.

  • Sie unterstützen bei der Analyse und Lösung technischer Probleme und koordinierst das Troubleshooting mit internen Teams und Lieferanten.

  • Sie überprüfen die Wirtschaftlichkeit unserer Produkte und koordinierst Lieferantenaudits.

Das bringen Sie mit

  • Erfahrung im Produkt- und Projektmanagement, idealerweise im Bereich Kassensysteme oder Hardware.

  • Gutes technisches Verständnis für Hardware- und Softwarelösungen.

For this role, we will only consider candidates who are currently based in the Netherlands.

About SkinVision

Skin cancer is highly treatable when caught early, but limited access to specialist care and long wait times delay diagnosis, increasing the risk of late-stage cases and driving up treatment costs. SkinVision, founded in Amsterdam in 2012, exists to close that gap. Our proprietary AI — certified as a Class IIa medical device under EU regulation, with over 90% sensitivity and 89% specificity — has already helped nearly 3 million people worldwide detect early signs of skin cancer. Today, SkinVision has a database of more than 6 million skin spot assessments and can reach 20 million people through insurer partnerships. High-risk cases are reviewed by a team of dermatologists, who support users in taking the right next step — from urgent care to a specialist referral. We are extending this further, connecting users faster to the specialist care they need. We're a focused, international team, active globally, united by one goal: making early detection accessible to everyone, everywhere. If you join us, you're not just building a product — you're helping close the gap between a person noticing something and getting the care they need.

Senior UX Designer at SkinVision

You will conduct user research, create wireframes and prototypes, and work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure our platform provides the best possible user experience. Your work will directly contribute to making early skin cancer detection accessible and user-friendly.

jobs.title: TCS and ECLSS Certification Engineer
jobs.description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

Mission

We are developing, manufacturing, and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable spacecraft which will carry cargo to space stations and potentially humans in the longer run.

We are seeking an experienced Certification Engineer to join our Thermal Control System & Environmental Control and Life Support System team. You will be responsible for leading, coordinating, and driving the certification and verification closure activities of the Nyx Thermal Control System (TCS) and Environmental Control and Life Support System (ECLSS) in support of vehicle qualification, NASA certification, and flight acceptance.

The role serves as the primary focal point between the TCS & ECLSS teams, System Engineering, Verification & Validation, Chief Engineering Office, AIT, Program, Safety Engineering, and external stakeholders. The Certification Engineer ensures that TCS and ECLSS requirements are properly allocated, verified, traceable, and closed with appropriate evidence, while maintaining alignment with NASA SSP requirements, Data Item Deliverables (DIDs), verification plans, and Safety Review Panel expectations.

The position requires a strong understanding of spacecraft systems engineering, thermal engineering, verification methodologies, qualification logic, and agency review processes to ensure that technical evidence across both subsystems is complete, credible, traceable, and accepted by the certification authorities.

Key Responsibilities

Lead Thermal & ECLSS Verification Closure Activities

  • Own the verification closure process for TCS and ECLSS, from subsystem level through spacecraft-level qualification.

  • Ensure TCS and ECLSS requirements are allocated to appropriate verification methods.

  • Coordinate the preparation, execution, and closure of verification events with analysts, product owners, subsystem engineers, system engineers, and test teams.

  • Maintain consistency between the TCS & ECLSS verification strategies and spacecraft-level verification planning.

  • Ensure analyses, test reports, inspection records, NCRs, requirement justifications, and review documentation are available to support certification closure.

  • Support the preparation of qualification, certification, and flight readiness reviews.

  • Ensure consistency of verification logic and evidence across TCS and ECLSS, particularly for requirements, interfaces, functions, or verification activities involving both subsystems.

Manage NASA Requirement Compliance and Verification Product

  • Act as the TCS & ECLSS focal point for NASA certification and verification activities.

  • Coordinate the closure of applicable NASA SSP requirements and associated verification products, including the DIDs.

  • Ensure consistency between analyses, test results, requirements, qualification rationale, and certification documentation across both subsystems.

  • Maintain alignment between NASA verification expectations and TEC verification approaches.

  • Coordinate with TCS and ECLSS technical owners to ensure certification evidence is technically robust and delivered according to program and customer milestones.

Lead Thermal & ECLSS Contributions to Safety Reviews

  • Prepare and coordinate TCS & ECLSS contributions to NASA Safety Reviews.

  • Ensure TCS and ECLSS hazards, controls, verification evidence, and closure rationale are fully documented.

  • Support and coordinate the development of safety review presentations and supporting technical packages.

  • Ensure consistency between hazard reports, verification evidence, and qualification activities.

  • Coordinate with Safety Engineering and subsystem technical owners to ensure certification evidence supporting hazard-control verification is identified and available.

Support Qualification and Test Campaigns

  • Ensure qualification, acceptance, development, and integrated test campaigns provide the evidence required for certification.

  • Identify verification gaps early and drive mitigation actions.

  • Support preparation of verification plans, qualification matrices, and closure notices.

  • Participate in major test reviews and assess certification impacts of anomalies and non-conformances.

  • Support requirement closure from TVAC, Thermal Balance, functional testing, and integrated spacecraft verification campaigns.

  • Drive the closure of actions and verification-related NCRs

 

Required Qualifications

Technical

  • MSc or equivalent degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related field.

  • Strong understanding of spacecraft thermal control system, ECLSS, and spacecraft development processes.

  • Experience with spacecraft verification and qualification methodologies.

  • Familiarity with NASA and/or ECSS verification standards, requirements management, verification matrices, and closure processes.

  • Understanding of thermal analyses, thermal testing, qualification logic, and evidence generation.

Experience

  • 8+ years of experience in spacecraft development, system engineering, verification, certification, or thermal engineering.

  • Experience supporting spacecraft design reviews and qualification campaigns.

  • Experience interfacing with external customers, agencies, or certification authorities.

  • Experience managing complex technical documentation and evidence packages.

Personal Skills

  • Strong organization, coordination, technical writing, and communication skills.

  • Ability to drive closure of multidisciplinary actions across engineering teams.

  • High level of rigor, traceability, and attention to detail.

  • Ability to challenge assumptions and ensure certification readiness.

  • Comfort presenting technical material to senior engineering leadership and external review boards.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. 
 
The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable.

jobs.title: Senior Data & AI Architect
Senior Data & AI Architect
Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Jij zet AI-projecten op vanuit de inhoud en leidt ze tot een tevreden klant.

Een sterk model bouwen is één ding. Een klant laten zien wat AI voor hem kan doen, de juiste oplossing bedenken en die betrouwbaar in productie krijgen: dat is jouw vak.

Als Senior AI Engineer combineer je diepgang in machine learning en MLOps met diepgang in generatieve AI, LLM's en agents. Je bent erbij vanaf het eerste klantgesprek en bent als delivery lead eindverantwoordelijk voor de oplevering.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Nieuwe projecten opzetten: van eerste gesprek tot proposal, met steun van sales. Je inspireert de klant vanuit de inhoud, bedenkt de oplossing en zet een degelijke projectplanning neer.

  • De oplevering leiden: als delivery lead doe je het projectmanagement, geef je dagelijks leiding aan de uitvoering en voer je het stakeholdermanagement.

  • Technische keuzes maken en meebouwen: je ontwerpt de architectuur van data-, ML- en agentsystemen en bouwt zelf mee. Met een FDE in het team werk je het agentic ontwerp samen uit.

  • Naar productie en draaiend houden: MLOps, monitoring, security en onderhoudbaarheid zijn bij jou geen bijzaak.

  • Het team optillen: je begeleidt collega's en helpt standaarden te ontwikkelen.

Projecten die verder gaan dan het model

We richten ons op retail en e-commerce, finance en utilities. Denk aan:

  • Prognoses waar planners op durven te sturen, van retailassortiment tot netbelasting.

  • Intelligente documentverwerking, zoals KYC-dossiers of inspectierapporten, met herleidbare bronnen.

  • Agents die werk voorbereiden in klantenservice en backoffice, met evals en guardrails.

  • Computer vision, zoals in de fitnessbranche, waar we onveilige situaties in onbemande 24/7-locaties herkennen.

De uitdaging zit niet alleen in het model, maar ook in betrouwbaarheid, integratie en de werking in de praktijk.


Wat breng je mee?

  • Diepgang in ML engineering en MLOps én in GenAI, LLM's en agents, met oplossingen die je zelf in productie hebt gebracht en onderhouden.

  • Je ontwerpt de architectuur van data-, ML- en agentsystemen, met oog voor evals, monitoring, security en de EU AI Act.

  • Sterk in Python en SQL, en hands-on met minimaal één cloud (Azure, AWS of GCP) en een dataplatform zoals Databricks, Snowflake of Fabric.

  • Ervaring met business development én als delivery lead of projectleider.

  • Je werkt dagelijks met coding agents en beoordeelt kritisch wat ze opleveren.

  • Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels.

Wat dit níet is

  • Geen individuele detachering. Je werkt aan projecten namens adesso, met een team achter je.

  • Geen notebook-kerkhof. Een model is pas af als het in productie draait en gebruikt wordt.

  • Geen GenAI omdat het kan. Soms is een klassiek model beter, soms een LLM; jij kiest wat past.

  • Geen werk op afroep. Je denkt vanaf de klantvraag mee, niet pas als het ontwerp al vastligt.

Het team

Je wordt onderdeel van ons AI Engineering-team: AI engineering consultants in twee rollen. De Forward Deployed AI Engineer (FDE) is eigenaar van het klantprobleem en ontwerpt de oplossing, inclusief de agentic architectuur. De AI Engineer gaat de diepte in op bouw, data, MLOps en schaal, en denkt vanaf de klantvraag mee over de juiste aanpak.

Je krijgt ruimte om je eigen werk vorm te geven, maar je bent nooit alleen verantwoordelijk voor alle specialismen.

Twijfel je welke rol het best bij je past? Solliciteer dan gewoon; we kijken samen. 

Waarom adesso? Omdat je bij ons écht kunt meebouwen.

Bij adesso Nederland draait het om meer dan alleen technologie. We bouwen slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Geen eindeloze experimenten of AI omdat het hip is, maar technologie die werkt en impact maakt.

We zijn onderdeel van de internationale adesso Group, met ruim 11.500 collega's op meer dan 60 locaties. Tegelijkertijd zijn we in Nederland een relatief klein en persoonlijk team, met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief.

Groot genoeg om impact te maken, klein genoeg om het verschil te voelen.

AI-native: wij omarmen AI, ook in ons eigen werk

We geloven dat AI fundamenteel verandert hoe we software bouwen, met data werken en klanten helpen. Daarom bouwen we niet aan losse experimenten, maar aan dataplatformen, AI-first applicaties en agentic oplossingen die echt onderdeel worden van bedrijfsprocessen.

Dat geldt ook voor hoe we zelf werken. Met onze Agentic Delivery-aanpak en eigen tools kun je echt vliegen:

  • Context en kennisbank: agents werken met wat er écht speelt bij de klant, en kennis en beslissingen blijven herleidbaar voor mens én agent.

  • AgentOps en governance: zicht op wat agents doen en controle over wat ze mogen, zodat ze veilig en binnen de regels werken.

  • adSCAILE: ons eigen framework waarmee je samen met AI-agents bouwt, geïntegreerd, veilig en traceerbaar, in cycli van twee tot vier dagen in plaats van sprints van weken.

Je gebruikt deze tools dagelijks en helpt ze verder te ontwikkelen. adesso is bovendien Select Partner in het Claude Partner Network van Anthropic. En we blijven kritisch: niet alles hoeft met AI. De beste oplossing staat altijd voorop.

En misschien wel het belangrijkste: de mensen

Je komt terecht in een team waar vakmanschap, ondernemerschap en kennisdeling centraal staan. Je werkt met ervaren specialisten en groeit door in technische visie en in verantwoordelijkheid voor klantrelaties.

We houden van collega's die nieuwsgierig zijn, kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Mensen die goed zijn in hun vak, maar ook plezier hebben in samenwerken. Je krijgt bij ons vertrouwen, verantwoordelijkheid en de vrijheid om ideeën daadwerkelijk uit te voeren.

Wat krijg je van ons?

  • €5.850–€7.150 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur

  • 8% vakantiegeld

  • Contract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week

  • Een leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding naar keuze, bovenop je salaris

  • 27 vakantiedagen en 4 studiedagen

  • €3.600 persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget per jaar en ruimte voor certificeringen

  • Hybride werken met flexibele werktijden

  • Goede pensioenregeling

  • Doorgroeimogelijkheden in een specialistenspoor

  • Internationale kennis en ontwikkelmogelijkheden, gecombineerd met een hecht Nederlands team

Zullen we kennismaken?

Je hoeft niet aan ieder technisch punt te voldoen. We zijn vooral benieuwd naar wat je hebt gebouwd, welke keuzes je hebt gemaakt en waar je naartoe wilt groeien.

Een cv of LinkedIn-profiel is genoeg om het gesprek te starten. Daarna volgen een kennismaking, een technisch gesprek en een praktijkcase.

Bij adesso werk je niet alleen aan de technologie van morgen. Je krijgt ook de ruimte om mee te bepalen hoe we die bouwen.
