jobs.title: IT Support Specialist L2 (f/m/x)
jobs.description:
Our goal is to have a solar system on every roof, a storage unit in every house, and an electric car in every garage. Enpal makes this possible with an integrated total solution for decentralized energy—from solar systems and battery storage to wall boxes, smart meters, and heat pumps. At the heart of it all is our AI-powered platform Enpal.One+, which intelligently connects thousands of systems and efficiently optimizes electricity procurement and feed-in on the energy market.

Are you ready for solutions that are more than just a promise and bring real quality of life to thousands of households every day? What you create at Enpal will deliver clean electricity tomorrow and bring about lasting change in how we use energy.

 

We are looking for a hands-on IT Support Specialist to join our IT team in Berlin.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving technical problems, takes ownership of their work, and thrives in a fast-paced environment where priorities can change quickly.

You will be responsible for providing reliable IT support, managing incidents and service requests, supporting device lifecycle operations, and ensuring a smooth employee experience.

 

We are looking for someone who can work independently, communicate confidently with stakeholders, and balance urgent requests with structured service delivery.

 

What you'll do:

  • Own and resolve L1/L2 technical support requests end-to-end, ensuring timely resolution and adherence to SLAs.

  • Provide hands-on walk-in and remote IT support across multiple locations.

  • Troubleshoot hardware, software, connectivity and application issues across Windows, MacOS, iOS and Android devices.

  • Manage, prioritize and document tickets in Jira Service Management or similar ITSM platforms.

  • Investigate recurring incidents, identify potential root causes and collaborate with relevant teams on resolution.

  • Escalate complex issues appropriately while maintaining ownership and tracking progress.

  • Manage competing priorities in a high-volume support environment while maintaining service quality.

  • Configure, deploy and maintain laptops, mobile devices and peripherals using Microsoft Intune and other endpoint management tools.

  • Maintain accurate IT asset records, including device assignments, returns, replacements and inventory.

  • Support hardware lifecycle activities, including provisioning, repairs and secure disposal, in line with IT security policies.

  • Support employee onboarding and offboarding, including device preparation, access provisioning, equipment handovers and returns.

  • Assist with large onboarding waves, ensuring timely preparation, tracking and delivery of devices.

  • Troubleshoot Microsoft Teams Rooms, conferencing equipment and related AV systems.

  • Provide technical support for Microsoft 365, Teams and other workplace collaboration tools.

  • Identify opportunities to improve support processes, reduce recurring issues and enhance the employee experience.

  • Create and maintain technical documentation, troubleshooting guides and knowledge base articles.

  • Collaborate with distributed IT teams to ensure consistent service delivery across locations.

  • Communicate proactively with employees and stakeholders, setting realistic expectations and providing timely updates.

  • Follow established IT processes, security standards and escalation procedures.

 

What you'll bring:

  • 3+ years of hands-on IT support experience in a corporate or enterprise environment.

  • Strong troubleshooting skills across Windows and macOS environments.

  • Practical experience supporting Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) and enterprise applications.

  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Intune or similar endpoint management tools.

  • Experience with ITSM platforms such as Jira Service Management.

  • Understanding of ITIL principles, incident management, request fulfilment and SLA-driven support.

  • Experience with hardware provisioning, device troubleshooting and IT asset management.

  • Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks and manage competing requests.

  • Strong communication and customer service skills, including handling challenging situations professionally.

  • A proactive, accountable and solution-oriented approach.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting large-scale onboarding and offboarding operations.

  • Familiarity with Snipe-IT or similar IT asset management systems.

  • Experience troubleshooting Microsoft Teams Rooms and audiovisual equipment.

  • Basic networking knowledge, including VPN, DNS, DHCP and connectivity troubleshooting.

  • Basic scripting knowledge using PowerShell or Bash.

  • Familiarity with Microsoft Defender and endpoint security concepts.

  • Experience working with distributed or international IT teams.

  • Awareness of ISO 27001, GDPR and IT security best practices.

     

Are you interested even if you don't meet all the requirements? Apply anyway! We look forward to discovering your potential—regardless of whether your experience meets every single requirement. ☀️

 

What we offer:

  • Work at Germany's first green unicorn - Play an active role in shaping the solar energy transition.

  • The sun shines all over the world - At Enpal, you'll work with a highly motivated, diverse team of over 65 nationalities.

  • The ideal setup for your focus - We are convinced that excellent results are achieved when the conditions are right. That's why we rely on a hybrid working concept that gives you the freedom to always work in the way that best suits your tasks. Do you need new inspiration on an international level? With Workflex, we offer you the opportunity to relocate abroad for up to 30 days a year, depending on your responsibilities.

  • Grown-up business & startup spirit - In our modern office in Berlin-Friedrichshain, you'll find everything your heart desires, from height-adjustable desks and table tennis to stocked beverage fridges and barista coffee.

  • Your kick-start at Enpal - Onboarding day with a welcome bag, buddy program, and a team that really supports you.

  • Stay up to date & help shape the future - Transparent all-hands meetings, short decision-making processes, and an open feedback culture - without mistakes, there is no progress.

  • The energy transition can only be achieved together - At Enpal, you can expect legendary team spirit and unforgettable team events.

  • Your extra boost - 29 vacation days + one additional day off on Christmas Eve and New Year's Eve, discounted membership at Wellhub, and corporate benefits. Everything you need to help you achieve a good work-life balance.

  • Investing in your future – We don’t just think sustainably when it comes to energy, but also when it comes to you. Take advantage of our company pension scheme to build a solid foundation for your future, step by step.

  • Make your home smart – Sustainability starts at your doorstep. As part of our team, you’ll benefit from a permanent 25% discount on the entire Bosch Smart Home product range – for an even more efficient and connected home.

     

At Enpal, we are proud of the diversity of our team. No decisions are made on the basis of skin colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability or age, either during recruitment or employment. Enpal stands for a safe workplace and takes action against discrimination and harassment of any kind.

jobs.title: Senior Legal Counsel
jobs.description:
What do we do?

Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better.

We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 10,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally.

 

The role:

As Senior Legal Counsel, you will be a senior member of the Paddle legal and compliance team, reporting directly to Paddle’s Director of Legal. The Paddle legal team is well-respected and integrated into Paddle’s business. As a result, this role will require you to collaborate with other teams across the business, and advise cross-functionally, always with a view to empowering the business to achieve its goals while taking a long-term strategic view.

The role itself will be broad and varied, with a core regulatory element. You will be delivering first-rate legal advice in a fast-paced dynamic environment, identifying risk and balancing common sense with your legal expertise. You will be an excellent generalist, comfortable operating in areas of ambiguity.

As Senior Legal Counsel, you will consider the longer-term impacts whilst also being able to react quickly to deliver level-headed, creative and context-appropriate solutions to ensure the best possible customer experience in the ever changing tech space.

The role will be based in the UK but will be global in scope.

 

What you'll do:

You will support the Director of Legal in their duties and advise and partner with every team from across the business on a wide range of matters, including the following:

  • Leadership remit: As a senior member of the team, you will work as part of a small team of lawyers in a wide range of legal work, including corporate and governance matters, administration of Paddle’s international branches and subsidiaries, negotiating commercial agreements, regulatory research and advising our product and support teams. Your duties may include supervising in-house trainee lawyers seeking their SRA qualification.

  • Strategic commercial work: You will assist in the negotiation of strategic commercial contracts, including key supplier and customer agreements.

  • Strategic corporate work: You will assist with the negotiation of strategic corporate contracts, including financing agreements.

  • Regulatory advice (incl data protection):

    • You will lead on the identification and analysis of evolving rules and consumer regulations relevant to Paddle’s global MoR business model.

    • You will collaborate with the compliance function to develop and implement risk and compliance policies and procedures relevant to Paddle’s operations and the MoR business model.

    • You will draft, negotiate, and advise on data protection agreements, terms of service, privacy policies, and other privacy- and data-related contracts and disclosures, collaborating closely with the compliance function.

 

We'd love to hear from you if you:

  • You have a minimum of 8+ years of legal experience, with at least 3 years in-house at a regulated high-growth tech scale-up preferably in payments, FinTech, SaaS or related sectors.

  • You are a UK-qualified solicitor (preferably) or qualified in another common law or European jurisdiction.

  • You enjoy leading and working with junior team members, helping them to grow and realise their potential.

  • You are smart, curious, keen to learn and have a proven ability to quickly get across new and complex legal concepts.

  • You are used to working from first principles, applying common sense, and excited about answering questions you have never dealt with before.

  • You are an excellent and persuasive communicator used to partnering with a range of stakeholders across the business and externally.

  • You are skilled at tailoring your legal advice to the recipient, whether they be senior management or a junior contributor.

  • You are commercially-minded and able to deliver creative, helpful and practical solutions to a rapidly growing business, often operating under pressure and in an area characterized by ambiguity.

     

Everyone is welcome at Paddle

At Paddle, we’re committed to removing invisible barriers, both for our customers and within our own teams. We recognise and celebrate that every Paddler is unique and we welcome every individual perspective. As an inclusive employer, we don’t care if, or where, you studied, what you look like or where you’re from. We’re more interested in your craft, curiosity, passion for learning and what you’ll add to our culture. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t match every part of the job ad, especially if you’re part of an underrepresented group.

Please let us know if there’s anything we can do to better support you through the application process and in the workplace. We will do everything we can to support any accommodations needed. We’re committed to building a diverse team where everyone feels safe to be their authentic self. Let’s grow together.

 

Why you’ll love working at Paddle

We’re a diverse, growing group of Paddlers who pride ourselves on our transparent, collaborative and respectful culture.

We live and breathe our values, which are:

  • Paddle Together - “None of us, is as smart as all of us”

  • Paddle Simply - “Simple can be harder than complex: you have to get your thinking clean to make it simple”

  • Paddle for others - “We can realise our wildest dreams, so long as we help enough other people to realise theirs”

 

We offer a full suite of benefits, including attractive salaries, stock options, unlimited holidays, enhanced parental leave, retirement plans, private healthcare and well-being initiatives.

 

We invest in learning and will help you with your personal development via constant exposure to new challenges, an annual learning fund, and regular internal and external training.

 

Connecting at Paddle

We’re a ‘digital-first’ company, which means our Paddlers always have the freedom to choose where, when and how they work within our hub locations.

We recognize that where our Paddlers do their best work is unique to them and we provide trust and autonomy for everyone to work in a way which fits them best. We also value the power of connection and have invested in global hubs which help local communities flourish and bring us together for focused collaboration.

 

Our Paddle hubs:

  • In Europe: UK (London headquarters), Portugal (Lisbon hub), Netherlands and Ireland (Dublin hub)

  • In North America: Austin, TX (USA) and Toronto (Canada)

  • In APAC: Singapore

Our hub philosophy creates an engaging experience for all Paddlers, wherever, whenever and however we choose to work.

 

To support this, we focus hiring within our hubs and will always openly share the available locations for each open position on our job description.

jobs.title: Strategy & Operations Director
jobs.description:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As Strategy & Operations Lead of Doit Lithuania, you will build and run the business in Lithuania and grow it across the European Economic Area.

You will be the first senior hire in Lithuania. You will own the regulatory relationship, the build of the team, the partner network and the launch. You will sit on the management board and lead the business day to day.

We’re looking for a generalist who learns quickly, thinks deeply, and enjoys solving difficult problems in a fast-moving, regulated environment.

What You’ll Own

  • Own the relationship with the Bank of Lithuania and other regulators.

  • Build the Vilnius team, including compliance, operations and control functions.

  • Select and negotiate with execution, custody, fund and banking partners.

  • Own the business plan, financial projections, capital plan and budget.

  • Launch the investment platform in Lithuania and roll it out across the EEA.

  • Set up governance, policies and controls that meet EU and Lithuanian requirements.

  • Work with group leadership on product, engineering and growth.

  • Report to the board and take ownership of business and regulatory outcomes.

What We’re Looking For

  • Generalist background in consulting, investment banking, start-ups, private equity or venture capital.

  • Experience building or scaling a business, ideally in financial services or fintech.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and business judgment.

  • Ability to learn regulation quickly and work credibly with regulators.

  • Strong ownership and execution skills.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with boards, regulators, partners and teams.

  • Comfortable working across product, operations, finance and compliance.

  • A clean record and good reputation, suitable for regulatory approval as a senior manager.

  • Based in Lithuania, or open to relocating to Lithuania.

  • Curious, resourceful, and driven to build.

Nice to Have

  • Lithuanian language ability.

  • An existing working relationship with the Bank of Lithuania.

  • Experience with MiFID II, brokerage, wealth management or fund distribution.

  • Experience building or running a regulated financial business in the EU.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings.

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally.

  • Those who need fixed scope and slow timelines.

  • People who avoid messy cross-functional problems.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions.

  • People who see regulation as someone else’s problem.

Location

This role is based in Vilnius, Lithuania. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Vilnius office at least 3 days per week.

You must be a European citizen or already hold a valid right to work in Lithuania. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritised.

jobs.title: Head of E-commerce
jobs.description:
On réinvente l'imperméable. Pour de vrai.

On crée des imperméables colorés, modulables et fabriqués à partir de tissus recyclés. Pas pour faire comme tout le monde, mais pour donner enfin envie de porter un imperméable.

Aujourd'hui, nous sommes une vingtaine, avec un modèle multicanal : un réseau retail en plein développement, un e-commerce qui fonctionne bien et un B2B qui accélère.

Et surtout, on a encore beaucoup de choses à construire et de barrières à faire tomber.

C'est là que tu entres en action.

Le poste

On cherche quelqu'un qui a déjà scalé un e-commerce dans la mode — et qui a envie de recommencer avec une marque qui a quelque chose à dire.

Pas un manager qui supervise. Pas un consultant qui conseille. Un(e) Head of E-commerce qui exécute, qui teste, qui itère, et qui vient chercher le résultat lui-même. Tu travailles en direct avec le fondateur, sans couche intermédiaire, sans réunion de validation à n'en plus finir.

Tu prends le lead sur l'e-commerce de A à Z — et le site, c'est ton produit. Pas un outil qu'on subit, pas un chantier qu'on repousse : quelque chose qu'on améliore en continu, avec méthode, avec des données, et avec l'obsession que chaque visiteur devienne client.

Tu comprends que dans la mode, performance et image de marque ne s'opposent pas — ils se construisent ensemble, sur le long terme. Tu sais qu'une bonne décision d'acquisition peut abîmer une marque, et qu'une marque forte réduit le coût d'acquisition. C'est exactement ce qu'on veut construire chez Flotte.

Si tu cherches un poste où on te demande de « définir uniquement la vision », ce n'est pas ce poste. Si tu cherches un endroit où tu construis quelque chose qui compte, avec quelqu'un prêt à aller vite et à prendre des risques calculés — bienvenue.

Vos missions

Tes responsabilités concrètes

Le site, c'est ton produit

  • Tu « owns » le site de A à Z — pas juste sa performance marketing, mais son expérience, son évolution, sa roadmap
  • Tu priorises les développements avec notre prestataire tech : ce qui sort, dans quel ordre, pourquoi
  • Tu A/B testes en continu — pas une fois par trimestre, mais comme réflexe de travail
  • Tu détectes les points de friction avant que les clients se plaignent
  • Chaque page, chaque étape du tunnel a une raison d'être et un indicateur qui le prouve

Performance & acquisition

  • Piloter et optimiser les campagnes Meta / Google / TikTok (et challenge l'agence qui s'en charge)
  • Construire une stratégie d'acquisition rentable, cohérente avec l'image de marque — pas juste du volume à tout prix
  • Gérer la saisonnalité mode : anticiper les pics, optimiser les périodes creuses, ne jamais sacrifier l'image pour remplir un objectif court terme
  • Déployer un vrai tracking et ne plus naviguer à vue

CRM & retention

  • Structurer la base client, segmenter, personnaliser
  • Email, SMS, automation — construire des flows qui transforment les acheteurs en fans
  • LTV : la faire grimper

Vision 360 & cohérence omnicanale

  • Assurer la cohérence de l'expérience digitale sur tous les canaux : e-commerce, retail, B2B
  • Apporter un regard digital sur la stratégie B2B portée par l'équipe dédiée — sans empiéter sur leur terrain
  • Garantir que le site et les outils digitaux servent l'ensemble des canaux, pas seulement le DTC
  • Être le garant d'une image de marque cohérente quel que soit le point de contact

Développement international

  • Identifier et prioriser les marchés européens à fort potentiel pour Flotte (UK, Benelux, DACH, Nordics...)
  • Définir la stratégie de pénétration marché par marché : positionnement, canaux, pricing, timing
  • Travailler en binôme avec le pôle marketing & communication pour adapter l'image de marque aux marchés cibles sans en diluer l'ADN
  • Tester, mesurer, ajuster — pas de grand plan sur 3 ans, mais une approche structurée et itérative
  • Piloter les partenariats locaux (distributeurs, revendeurs, marketplaces) quand c'est le bon levier

Pilotage

  • Définir les bons KPIs, les suivre, les challenger
  • Être force de proposition sur le budget, les outils, la stack tech
  • Recruter et structurer une petite équipe quand on est prêts

Vos compétences

Le profil qu'on cherche vraiment

Tu as déjà fait le chemin dans la mode — et tu as envie de recommencer avec une marque qui a quelque chose à prouver.

Tu connais les contraintes du prêt-à-porter : les collections qui se succèdent, les stocks à piloter, la saisonnalité qui dicte le calendrier marketing, et la pression permanente de défendre une image de marque tout en délivrant de la performance. Tu sais qu'on ne construit pas une marque mode comme on scale un pure player généraliste. Et tu crois qu'on peut faire les deux.

  • 5 ansd'expérience en e-commerce, obligatoirement dans la mode ou le prêt-à-porter, avec au moins une expérience de scale probante — et des chiffres à l'appui
  • Tu ne sacrifies pas l'image de marque sur l'autel du ROAS — tu sais que la désirabilité d'une marque mode se construit sur le long terme et se détruit très vite
  • Une vision long terme : construire une marque qui dure, pas juste optimiser une saison
  • Un profil entrepreneur dans l'âme : tu penses business autant que tu penses acquisition, tu n'attends pas qu'on te dise quoi faire
  • Tu maîtrises Shopify, Meta Ads, Google Ads, un outil CRM (Klaviyo ou équivalent)
  • Tu exécutes — la stratégie c'est bien, mais sans exécution ça ne vaut rien
  • Tu es à l'aise pour travailler en direct avec un fondateur exigeant, sans filtre, avec franchise et sans ego
  • Anglais courant obligatoire.

Avantages

jobs.title: Shift Supervisor | DSL-01
jobs.description:
Shift Supervisor | DSL-01

Voor DSL-01 in Delfzijl zoeken wij een ervaren Shift Supervisor die vanaf de voorbereidingsfase meebouwt aan de operatie. Iemand die meedenkt over procedures, voorbereiding van de commissioning en startup en helpt om operators klaar te stomen voor het moment waarop de installatie daadwerkelijk gaat draaien. DSL-01 wordt een grootschalige productiefaciliteit voor Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) en bijproducten.

 

Over de functie

Als Shift Supervisor speel je een sleutelrol in de veilige, stabiele en efficiënte operatie van DSL-01. In deze functie krijg je een unieke combinatie van projectwerk en operationele verantwoordelijkheid. Tijdens de huidige projectfase draag je in dagdienst actief bij aan de voorbereiding van de fabrieksoperatie, commissioning en startup. Zodra DSL-01 operationeel is, gepland vanaf voorjaar 2028, geef je (in ploegendienst) leiding aan een ploeg operators en ben je verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse aansturing van een complexe chemische productie-installatie.

Je zorgt ervoor dat productie-, kwaliteits-, veiligheids- en milieudoelstellingen worden behaald en neemt de leiding wanneer zich afwijkingen, storingen of noodsituaties voordoen. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met collega's van Maintenance, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain en HSES.

Wat deze rol bijzonder maakt, is dat je niet instapt in een bestaande organisatie, maar vanaf het begin meebouwt aan de operatie, productie en manier van werken.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden

Tijdens de project- en opstartfase (~1,5 jaar):

  • Werk je in dagdienst

  • Draag je bij aan de commissioning en inbedrijfstelling van DSL-01

  • Ontwikkel je procedures en werkinstructies

  • Speel je een belangrijke rol in het uitvoeren van trainingsprogramma's en het trainen van operators

  • Ondersteun je bij de opbouw van de operationele organisatie

  • Zorg je voor een succesvolle voorbereiding op de start van de fabriek.

In de operationele fase (vanaf medio 2028):

  • Geef je leiding aan een team van ongeveer 8 operators in een 5-ploegendienst binnen een volcontinu productieproces.

  • Bewaak je de veilige en efficiënte productie van SAF, propaan, butaan en nafta.

  • Monitor je procesprestaties via DCS- en MES-systemen, stuur je bij waar nodig en zorg je ervoor dat productie-, kwaliteits- en rendementsdoelstellingen worden gerealiseerd.

Daarnaast ben je verantwoordelijk voor het naleven van veiligheids-, milieu- en kwaliteitsstandaarden, neem je de leiding bij incidenten en calamiteiten en coördineer je werkzaamheden tussen Operations, Maintenance en andere betrokken disciplines. Ook speel je een actieve rol in het continu verbeteren van processen en het verder versterken van de veiligheidscultuur binnen de fabriek.

Een belangrijk onderdeel van je rol is het ontwikkelen van het operationele team. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de groei van operators, zowel op technisch vlak als in competenties zoals samenwerking, eigenaarschap en veiligheidsbewustzijn. Door coaching, begeleiding en duidelijke verwachtingen zorg je voor een sterk team dat veilig, effectief en met vertrouwen kan opereren.

 

Jouw profiel

SkyNRG is een groeiende organisatie in een snel ontwikkelende markt. Daarom zoeken we mensen die zich prettig voelen in een omgeving waar nog niet alles vastligt en die actief willen bijdragen aan de verdere opbouw van de organisatie.

Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid, denkt vooruit en voelt je op je plek in een omgeving die continu in beweging is.

Je herkent jezelf in het volgende:

  • Ervaring en affiniteit met Procestechniek, Chemische Technologie of een vergelijkbare richting

  • Minimaal een afgeronde VAPRO C of AOT niveau 4-opleiding

  • Minimaal 10 jaar ervaring binnen de chemische, petrochemische, raffinage- of vergelijkbare procesindustrie

  • Aantoonbare operationele leidinggevende ervaring en bewezen people development skills

  • Ervaring met procesautomatisering en het werken met DCS- en MES-systemen

  • Kennis van procesveiligheid, werkvergunningensystemen en relevante wet- en regelgeving

  • Ervaring met het nemen van operationele beslissingen in situaties waar veiligheid, kwaliteit en continuïteit samenkomen

Welkome extra kennis en ervaring:

  • Ervaring binnen greenfield-projecten of grootschalige industriële bouw- en opstartprojecten

  • Ervaring met commissioning, startup en operational readiness

  • Kennis van raffinage-, hydroprocessing- of duurzame brandstofprocessen

  • Ervaring met continue verbeterprogramma's en performance management

Over DSL-01

In Delfzijl bouwen wij aan DSL-01, een fabriek van SkyNRG voor hernieuwbare brandstoffen. Hier produceren we Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) uit reststromen zoals gebruikte vetten en oliën, met HEFA-technologie. Daarnaast maken we bijproducten zoals butaan, propaan en nafta.

DSL-01 wordt de eerste fabriek in Europa die volledig gericht is op SAF en bijbehorende duurzame bijproducten. Als de fabriek in bedrijf is, produceren we jaarlijks 100.000 ton SAF en 35.000 ton bijproducten. Daarmee verminderen we de uitstoot van broeikasgassen met circa 80% ten opzichte van fossiele kerosine, gemeten over de hele keten.

De bouw is gestart in 2026 en de eerste productie staat gepland voor 2028. Het project omvat de fabriek zelf, bijbehorende leidingen en tijdelijke werkterreinen. Je draagt direct bij aan de realisatie van een nieuwe industriële fabriek en de verduurzaming van de luchtvaart.

We werken volgens internationale standaarden en Nederlandse wet- en regelgeving om de impact op mens, natuur en omgeving zorgvuldig te beheersen. Veiligheid, duurzaamheid en samenwerking staan daarbij centraal.

Waarom deze rol?

Deze functie biedt een kans die maar weinig operators en shift supervisors krijgen. Je bent vanaf een vroeg stadium betrokken bij de realisatie van een compleet nieuwe fabriek en kunt jouw operationele expertise inzetten om invloed uit te oefenen op commissioning, procedures, opleidingen en de uiteindelijke manier van werken.

Na de opstart maak je de stap naar een operationele omgeving waarin je leiding geeft aan een moderne productie-installatie en een belangrijke rol speelt in het neerzetten van de standaarden, cultuur en prestaties van de fabriek.

Tegelijkertijd draag je direct bij aan de realisatie van een van Europa's eerste grootschalige SAF-fabrieken. Een unieke kans om mee te bouwen aan een nieuwe productieorganisatie én een tastbare bijdrage te leveren aan de verduurzaming van de luchtvaart.

NB: Voor de opbouw van de operationele organisatie zoeken we uiteindelijk vijf Shift Supervisors. De eerste twee Supervisors starten tijdens de project- en opstartfase van DSL-01. De overige drie posities worden naar verwachting in het voorjaar ingevuld, zodat het volledige team gereed is voor de operationele fase. ‌

 

Solliciteer

Wil jij meewerken aan de succesvolle realisatie van een nieuwe fabriek en het resultaat van je werk terugzien in de praktijk? Dan is dit je kans om bij te dragen aan de ontwikkeling van duurzame luchtvaart.

NB: Een medische keuring maakt vanwege veiligheids- en gezondheidsredenen onderdeel uit van de selectieprocedure voor deze functie. ‌

 

Meer weten over DSL-01 en SkyNRG? Kijk op www.skynrg.com.

📌 Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

SkyNRG is een werkgever die gelijke kansen biedt. We zetten ons in voor een inclusieve werkomgeving en beoordelen alle sollicitanten op basis van hun kwaliteiten, ongeacht afkomst, huidskleur, religie, nationaliteit, geslacht, seksuele oriëntatie, genderidentiteit of -expressie, leeftijd, beperking of andere wettelijk beschermde kenmerken.

Compensation: €4,583 – €6,000 per month

jobs.description:
Location: Germany/Berlin/Stuttgart 

(Remote) 

 

Who You’ll Work For: 

 

At Makersite, we're pioneering the future of sustainable product development and digital collaboration. As a leading platform for product lifecycle management (PLM), we empower companies to make smarter, more sustainable decisions across their entire supply chain. Our cutting-edge software enables teams to design, prototype, and manufacture with transparency, efficiency, and responsibility—reducing environmental impact while optimizing performance. 

We're a fast-growing, innovative company that thrives on creativity, collaboration, and continuous learning. If you're passionate about technology, sustainability, and creating meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you. Join us and be a part of shaping the future of manufacturing and product innovation. 

 

Who we're looking for: 

 

As part of our growing team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of sustainable product development. We’re looking for innovative, driven Site Reliability Engineers who are passionate about technology and sustainability to join us in building tools that enable companies to make smarter, more responsible decisions. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with talented professionals, contribute to cutting-edge projects, and help drive the digital transformation of industries worldwide. If you're ready to make an impact and contribute to meaningful change, we want to hear from you! 

This role is a fixed, permanent position. All successful applicants will need to reside in Germany with legal working permits or residence permits.  

 

The role:  

 

  • Infrastructure Management: Maintain and manage new and existing infrastructure, balancing both proactive and reactive maintenance. 

  • Technical Problem Identification and Resolution: Identify technical problems and bottlenecks. Collaborate with the engineering team to resolve these issues efficiently. 

  • ISO Compliance: Ensure all infrastructure and processes are in compliance with ISO standards, and assist in maintaining those certifications. 

  • Production Support: Work closely with engineering teams to ensure our developed tools and applications run smoothly in a production environment. 

  • Backup Management: Oversee and manage all system backups, ensuring Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO) are met. 

  • Release Management Support: Assist in managing software releases to minimize disruption and maximize uptime. 

  • Off-Duty Support: Participate in an off-duty or pager duty rotation to provide round-the-clock system reliability and support. 

  • Incident Review and Analysis: Lead postmortems following any system disruptions, and help identify ways to prevent future incidents. 

  • Infrastructure Monitoring: Monitor system alerts and respond quickly to maintain system health and maximize uptime. 

  • Capacity Planning: Participate in planning server capacity, ensuring we can meet current and future demands 


  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or a related field. 

  • 7+ years of experience in site reliability engineering or a similar role.

  • 3+ years in SRE, DevOps, or related infrastructure roles  

  • Experience supporting/coaching less experienced team members. 

  • Ability in building alerting and observability into all production systems (Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch etc.)

  • Proven experience with cloud platforms, preferably AWS (ECS, EC2, etc) or Azure. 

  • Extensive experience using Terraform and Ansible. 

  • Incident management, postmortems, and on-call quality of life experience

  • Familiarity with disaster recovery planning and testing. 

  • Strong knowledge of system monitoring tools. 

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot complex issues. 

  • Strong communication and teamwork skills. 

  • Proven experience managing system backups and understanding of RTO and RPO. 

  • Familiarity with release management processes. 

  • Ability to work in an on-call capacity. 

  • Define the Site Reliability Strategy and Execute on it 

  • Experience in managing Stakeholders and expectations from Stakeholders 

  • Experience in dealing with concurring priorities / context switching 

  • Proficiency in Python.

 

What We Offer: 

 

  • Competitive Salary – We reward your skills and experience with a compensation package that reflects your value. 

  • 30 Days Paid Time Off – Take the time you need to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance. 

  • Remote-First Flexibility – Work from anywhere in Germany, with the option to collaborate in person at our offices in Stuttgart, Berlin (role dependent). 

  • Generous Learning & Development Budget – We invest in your growth, providing ample resources for personal and professional development. 

  • Choose Your Ideal Work Equipment – Whether you prefer Apple or Microsoft, we’ll equip you with the tools you need to excel. 

 

 

The Experience: 

 

  • Purpose-Driven Work – Build something meaningful. Here, you’re not just creating another app; you’re contributing to a transformative vision that you can be proud of. 

  • Great Colleagues – Join a team that’s open, transparent, and international. We value inclusivity and foster a culture of collaboration and mutual respect. 

  • Work-Life Balance – As a remote-first company, we trust you to do your best work, your way. You have the flexibility to work when it suits you, ensuring a healthy balance between personal and professional life. 

  • Pride in Impact – We're already making a significant difference with global, well-known customers who share our vision. Be part of something that matters. 

  • Stability with Ambition – With realistic growth plans, we’re committed to changing the way things are made—without sacrificing our ambitious goals for innovation and impact. 

 

 

If you want to find out more about what it’s like to work at Makersite, check out our Careers Page here

If you have a medical condition or an individual need for an adjustment to our process, and you believe this may affect your ability to be at your best – please let us know so we can talk about how we can best support you and make any adjustments that may be needed.

jobs.title: Superviseur support client international (Support technique opération de tracking sportif) - (H/F)
jobs.description:
McLloyd est une PME technologique française spécialisée dans les solutions de tracking appliquées aux courses. Nos technologies sont notamment utilisées dans plus de 13000 courses hippiques annuelles organisées en France et à l’international.

Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités, notamment en Australie puis aux États-Unis, nous créons un nouveau pôle de supervision chargé d’accompagner nos clients pendant leurs opérations. Ce service a vocation à évoluer progressivement vers une couverture internationale 24 heures sur 24 et 7 jours sur 7. L’équipe, constituée dans un premier temps de deux superviseurs, sera amenée à s’étoffer pour atteindre probablement quatre personnes.

Nous recherchons aujourd’hui notre nouveau superviseur pour participer au lancement et à la construction de ce pôle.

Vos missions

Votre mission

Pendant les opérations de tracking, vous serez le premier point de contact du client. Vous prendrez en charge ses demandes, réaliserez les premières vérifications, résoudrez les incidents simples en direct et transmettrez les situations nécessitant une expertise complémentaire à notre équipe d’ingénieurs (ticketing)

Il s’agit d’un poste opérationnel et technique, sans responsabilité managériale.

Vos principales responsabilités

  • Superviser à distance le bon déroulement des opérations de tracking ;

  • Répondre aux sollicitations des clients pendant les plages de couverture ;

  • Recueillir et qualifier les informations nécessaires à la compréhension d’un incident ;

  • Effectuer les premières vérifications et appliquer les procédures de dépannage ;

  • Résoudre les incidents de premier niveau ;

  • Créer, documenter et suivre les tickets dans notre outil interne ;

  • Transmettre aux ingénieurs les incidents nécessitant une expertise technique approfondie ;

  • Informer le client de l’avancement de sa demande et suivre l’incident jusqu’à sa résolution ou sa transmission complète ;

  • Tenir à jour la documentation interne ;

  • Rédiger les comptes rendus d’opération (% de réussite, interventions et résolutions) quotidiens et mensuels

  • Préparer les opérations à venir et participer à l’amélioration continue du pôle de supervision.L’activité alterne des périodes de supervision en temps réel et des périodes consacrées à la préparation des opérations, au suivi des tickets, à la documentation et à l’amélioration des procédures.

Organisation du travail et horaires

Le poste est organisé en temps plein annualisé. Le planning est établi à l’avance selon le calendrier international des courses et fonctionne par rotation entre les membres de l’équipe.

  • Horaires de journée, prises de poste tôt le matin et horaires de soirée ;

  • À terme, horaires de nuit dans le cadre du développement aux États-Unis ;

  • Travail régulier le week-end et certains jours fériés ;

  • Répartition des plages de couverture entre les superviseurs selon un système de rotation.

Actuellement, certaines opérations peuvent commencer dès 3 heures et se terminer jusqu’à 22 heures. Avec le développement de nos activités aux États-Unis, certaines plages de supervision pourront être réalisées pendant la nuit.

L’organisation des rotations sera réalisée dans le respect du temps de travail annualisé, des temps de repos et des dispositions légales et conventionnelles applicables. Les heures de nuit, du dimanche et des jours fériés donneront lieu aux majorations ou compensations prévues au sein de l’entreprise. Cette organisation implique une réelle disponibilité et l’acceptation d’horaires variables. Elle ne signifie toutefois pas que chaque superviseur travaillera systématiquement la nuit ou tous les week-ends.

Vos compétences

Profil recherché

  • Personne sérieuse, ponctuelle, fiable, calme et méthodique face à un incident ;

  • Autonomie et capacité à travailler efficacement à distance ;

  • Aisance dans la relation client, par téléphone comme par écrit ;

  • Capacité à recueillir des informations précises et à les transmettre clairement ;

  • Aisance avec les outils informatiques et les environnements techniques ;

  • Respect des procédures et attention portée à la qualité de la documentation ;

  • Disponibilité pour travailler selon un planning tournant comprenant des horaires de jour, de nuit, de week-end et certains jours fériés ;

  • Connexion internet stable et environnement adapté au télétravail.

Anglais courant obligatoire, à l’oral comme à l’écrit.

Une expérience professionnelle d’au moins deux ans en support client, assistance technique, supervision d’opérations, exploitation informatique, maintenance à distance ou gestion d’incidents est requise.

La connaissance du secteur hippique constitue un plus, mais elle n’est pas indispensable. Une formation aux solutions et aux procédures Mclloyd sera assurée en interne.

Avantages

Conditions proposées

  • CDI à temps plein annualisé ;

  • Majorations ou compensations applicables aux horaires concernés ;

  • Poste exercé à 100 % en télétravail, exclusivement depuis un lieu de travail déclaré situé sur le territoire français. Le télétravail depuis l’étranger n’est pas autorisé

  • Planning organisé par rotation et communiqué à l’avance ;

  • Déplacements ponctuels possibles au siège ou sur certaines opérations, notamment pendant la période de formation ;

  • Formation technique assurée en interne ;

  • Participation à la création d’un nouveau pôle stratégique pour le développement international de Mac-Lloyd.

Pourquoi rejoindre McLloyd

Vous intégrerez une PME technologique en pleine évolution et participerez directement à la création d’un nouveau service international. Vous occuperez un poste concret, autonome et utile aux clients, au contact d’opérations sportives organisées en France et à l’étranger. Vous contribuerez également à la définition des procédures et à l’organisation d’une équipe amenée à se développer progressivement

jobs.description:
About You

You have a knack for solving intricate Software Development problems. You're driven by the idea of writing code that simplifies life for millions of users globally. You're committed to continuous learning and enjoy tackling new challenges. Pair programming, code reviews, and collaborative brainstorming with a team are activities you find fulfilling. You're eager to work alongside developers, prospective customers, account executives, product managers, data scientists, and data analysts. You're a disciplined professional who consistently delivers high-quality code that you take full ownership of, communicates technical solutions with clarity and empathy, and takes the initiative to streamline processes for your team and yourself.

About Us

Constructor is the next-generation platform for search and discovery in ecommerce, built on a unique GPT-based architecture made specifically for commerce. Constructor's AI-first solutions make it easier for shoppers to discover products they want to buy and for ecommerce teams to deliver highly personalized experiences, from search, to recommendations, to AI Shopping Agents and everything in between. Optimizing specifically for ecommerce metrics like revenue, conversion rate and profit, Constructor generates consistent $10M+ lifts for some of the biggest brands in ecommerce, such as Sephora, Petco, Under Armour, home24, Birkenstock and The Very Group. Constructor is a U.S. based company that has been in the market since 2019. It was founded by Eli Finkelshteyn and Dan McCormick who still lead the company today.

We’re a passionate team who love solving problems and want to make our customers’ and coworkers’ lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they think is best can lead to great things.

About the Position

As a Software Engineer on the Prospect UI Solutions team, you will play a pivotal role in proving how Constructor will enhance the website discovery experiences for prospects. You’ll work closely with internal Engineering, Product and Sales stakeholders to seamlessly integrate prospective customer data with our services, supporting them to create an optimized and accurate product discovery demo.

In this role, you will:

  • Fuel our proprietary AI models: Write JavaScript code to collect data essential for training our AI.

  • Leverage Modern Tooling: Utilize AI as a tool to accelerate your fundamental capabilities and knowledge on how to solve problems with software; building solutions that you are proud to call your own

  • Seal the deal: Collaborate with Data Analysts and Account Executives to secure deals with prominent e-commerce brands.

  • Leverage your tech knowledge: Assist prospects in integrating their data and user interfaces with our services, focusing on ETL and front-end integrations.

  • Deliver excellence: Validate the data provided by prospects and ensure the quality of the results returned by our services.

  • Empower a sales force: Contribute to the development and scaling of demo infrastructure to enhance the demo capabilities of the Sales team.

  • Be a part of the answer: Assist Account Executives by addressing technical inquiries from prospects about our services.

  • Elevate the team: Provide support to your teammates through thoughtful code reviews and empathetic problem solving sessions.

  • Visualize brilliance: Develop dashboards and alerts using React, Redux, Node, Clickhouse and OpenSearch.

  • Innovate with purpose: Implement and test new features for our open-source JavaScript UI libraries and REST clients.

  • Collaborative contribution: Steer cross-team efforts to ensure our prospect's needs are at the forefront of our priorities, making you a key player in our strategic success.

  • Champion team culture: Actively foster our team’s sense of community by expanding our roster of Friday team-building games and promoting a culture of empathy, personal growth, and support for others.

This role is ideal for any Software Engineer passionate about search technology, customer-focused solutions, and collaborative development.

Requirements

  • A minimum of four years of professional experience or relevant academic experience

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

  • English on C1 level (CEFR) or higher

  • Being able to attend regular meetings with teammates between 1400 and 1800 UTC, with working hours ideally starting some time in the range of 0900 and 1200 UTC.

  • Strong foundation and experience with server-side and client-side programming languages

  • Enjoys interacting with customers and solving new problems daily

  • Able to pick up new technologies and design patterns quickly and loves learning them

  • Experience with building User Interfaces utilizing front-end frameworks like (but not limited to) React, Vue or Angular

  • Proven track record of building UIs with heavy consideration for friendly user experience

  • Experience with automated tests like (but not limited to) Cypress, Jest, or React Testing Library

  • Experience in JavaScript will be a strong asset for this role, but candidates with a proven Software Development background that demonstrate a willingness to quickly learn the language will also be considered

  • Nice to have - TypeScript, Next.js, Tailwind, Storybook, Python and web scraping experience

Benefits

  • 🏝️ Unlimited vacation time - we strongly encourage all of our employees take at least 3 weeks per year

  • 🌎 Fully remote team - choose where you live

  • 🛋️ Work from home stipend! We want you to have the resources you need to set up your home office

  • 💻 Apple laptops provided for new employees

  • 🧑‍🎓 Training and development budget for every employee, refreshed each year

  • 👪 Maternity & Paternity leave for qualified employees

  • 🧠 Work with smart people who will help you grow and make a meaningful impact

  • 💵 This position has a base salary range between $80k and $120k USD. The offer varies on many factors including job related knowledge, skills, experience, and interview results.

  • 🎉 Regular team offsites to connect and collaborate

As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome individuals of all backgrounds and provide equal opportunities to all applicants regardless of their education, diversity of opinion, race, color, religion, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status or affiliation in any other protected group.

jobs.description:
Thought Machine's mission is bold – to properly and permanently rid the world's banks of legacy technology. To achieve this, we have developed the foundations of modern banking through core and payments technology which run natively in the cloud. What we are attempting is hard and means we need great people working together to build great technology.

We have grown rapidly in the past few years – growing our team to more than 550 individuals across offices in London, New York, Singapore, Sydney and our newly established Engineering Hub in Lisbon. We have raised more than £500m in funding and our investors include Molten Ventures, Eurazeo, Intesa Sanpaolo, Temasek, Nyca Partners, JPMorgan Chase Strategic Investments, Standard Chartered Ventures, and more.

We have created a culture that enables our team to produce the best work in the industry while ensuring we have fun along the way. We're regularly cited as having a fantastic workplace culture and have been recognised by Sifted magazine as having one of the highest Glassdoor ratings for a UK fintech company and the industry's most generous employee share package. Named one of the world's most innovative fintechs by Global Finance Magazine, we were also recognised by the Financial Times as one of Europe's fastest-growing companies for two consecutive years—and a UK Best Employer for 2026.

Senior Software Engineer in Quality Engineering

Thought Machine is building the backbone of critical banking infrastructure worldwide, empowering the world’s largest financial institutions to modernise their operations. In this high-stakes environment, producing quality software isn't just a best practice, it is a fundamental imperative and the foundation of our clients' trust. We invest heavily in our testing architecture because the reliability of our software is critical to the global financial ecosystem.

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to drive quality engineering excellence, modern testing architecture and practices, and scalable infrastructure across our product engineering organisation.

This is a rigorous, hands-on backend software engineering position, not a traditional QA or SDET role. We do not believe in siloed testing teams; instead, we believe in building intelligent, automated infrastructure and AI-driven developer tooling that make high-quality delivery the default.

Why Join Us?

In this role, you will have the unique opportunity to solve complex challenges at a massive scale, directly impacting the velocity of our engineering teams and the stability of global banks. We want engineers to be at the forefront of transforming our testing platforms from an internal utility into a powerful commercial asset. By providing total transparency into how we test, deepening our collaboration with clients, and exposing these capabilities externally via managed offerings like "Testing as a Service" (TaaS), you will fundamentally shift how the industry perceives software quality.

You will work at the cutting edge of infrastructure and AI, honing your skills in building agentic tooling, advanced observability pipelines, and cloud-native platforms. This is a chance to elevate your career by architecting platforms that developers love and clients trust, all while shaping the engineering culture of a hyper-growth tech company.

You will partner closely with engineering leadership, product management, and developer platform teams to design, architect, and implement industry-leading testing infrastructure. You will act as a technical leader championing testability, observability, and engineering best practices across the entire development lifecycle for all of our products.

The Mentality We Are Looking For

We value engineers who combine rigorous technical craft with ownership, continuous learning, and a relentless focus on high-quality delivery.

  • "Toil is a Defect" Mindset: You view manual testing and complex debugging not as a necessity, but as a platform defect to be automated away using intelligent tooling and AI.

  • Guardrails, Not Gates: You believe in empowering developers with speed and observability, using quantitative metrics and automated telemetry to inform risk-based decisions rather than relying on bureaucratic red tape.

  • Technical Ownership & Excellence: You take pride in end-to-end delivery, from architectural design and coding to automated testing, performance optimization, and operational monitoring.

  • Collaborative Technical Leadership: You enjoy partnering with software engineers, product managers, and client-facing teams to elevate testing standards and foster a transparent culture of quality.

Duties

  • Enablement & AI Tooling: Design, build, research, evaluate and adopt advanced engineering tools, including leveraging Agentic AI for the automated triage of performance test failures, automated test-code generation, and eliminating developer toil.

  • Governance & Observability: Develop and integrate quantitative product reliability metrics for test coverage, execution speed and defect prevention, into CI/CD pipelines. Build telemetry and infrastructure for advanced testing paradigms, including deterministic fault injection to catch concurrency and race conditions.

  • Drive Quality Engineering Initiatives: Partner with engineering teams to conduct risk analyses, implement integration and performance testing strategies, and resolve complex edge-case defects.

  • Backend Engineering Delivery: Develop high-quality, testable, and robust backend services, APIs, and microservices in alignment with architecture standards.

  • Technical Mentorship: Mentor junior and mid-level engineers in test automation patterns, backend engineering design, unit/integration testing strategies, and code hygiene.

Requirements

  • Extensive hands-on experience in backend software development using modern languages (e.g., Go, Python) and cloud-native architecture.

  • Proven track record of designing and implementing scalable backend platforms, with deep expertise in CI/CD integration, containerisation, and orchestration (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Docker, Kubernetes).

  • Deep understanding of complex distributed systems, API protocols (REST/gRPC), and observability stacks (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, BigQuery).

  • Familiarity with leveraging modern AI-assisted tools and building agentic workflows for code generation, log analysis, and automated triage.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills to advocate for quality initiatives and influence cross-functional technical teams.

If you are passionate about building robust backend infrastructure, advancing quality engineering architecture, and leading software excellence, we want to hear from you.

Benefits

  • Pension plan (match up to 5%)

  • Life insurance - three times annual salary

  • Competitive maternity (six months fully paid) and paternity leave (four weeks fully paid)

  • Shared parental leave (matched to our maternity leave for the same point in time)

We work with brands like Allbirds, Reformation, and Alo Yoga, and we’re continuing to evolve Endear into an increasingly AI-first product built around how modern retail teams actually work.

Position Overview

We’re looking for a Product Designer to join our IRL (in real life) team, which owns the in-store side of Endear — including appointments, events, customer check-ins, and the administrative experiences behind those workflows.

You’ll design for store associates and managers running clienteling day to day, as well as admin users who help shape how those teams operate and manage their workflows.

In this role, you’ll own features and projects from understanding the problem through research, testing, iteration, and production-ready design, while partnering closely with our Head of Product Design on vision and direction.

The IRL roadmap is early. Many of these features don’t exist yet, so you’ll be defining problems through research before designing solutions.

This role is well suited for someone comfortable creating clarity when the solution isn’t obvious.

What You’ll Accomplish

In your first 6 months, you’ll…

  • Take ownership of IRL features from discovery through production-ready design

  • Build a strong understanding of how store associates, managers, and admin users work within Endear

  • Run research from early discovery through usability testing

  • Design complete, accessible product experiences, including loading, empty, error, permission, and other key states.

  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering to shape solutions early in the process

  • Use customer insight and data to inform design decisions and iteration

In your first year, you’ll…

  • Build deeper ownership across the IRL product

  • Deliver product experiences that improve how retail teams manage clienteling and in-store workflows

  • Build a strong rhythm of discovery, testing, and continuous learning

  • Strengthen your collaboration across Design, Product, and Engineering

  • Demonstrate clear user and business impact through the work you ship

You’ll Thrive in This Role If…

  • You enjoy taking ownership of a feature while collaborating closely on the broader vision and direction

  • You’re comfortable with ambiguity and zero-to-one product work

  • You naturally think beyond the happy path and account for edge cases and complete product states

  • You care about creating accessible experiences and solving the right problem, not just creating polished UI

  • You enjoy working closely with Product and Engineering throughout the design process

  • You’re comfortable using research, data, and customer feedback to guide decisions

  • You move quickly, seek feedback, and iterate based on what you learn

  • You’re curious about designing for AI

You Have Experience With

  • 2–5 years working in product design

  • Independently owning features from discovery through implementation, with support on vision and direction

  • Running user research from discovery through usability testing

  • Translating broad or ambiguous problems into clear product solutions

  • Working closely with Design, Product, and Engineering teams

  • Designing complex, accessible workflows and accounting for loading, empty, error, and permission states

  • Using qualitative and quantitative data to inform design decisions

  • Building within established design patterns while knowing when something needs to evolve

  • Using AI tools as part of your workflow and applying judgment to AI-generated output

  • A portfolio that demonstrates strong product thinking and execution, and where you can articulate the impact of your work, with data where you had access to it

Align With What We Value

At Endear, we live by five core principles. Here’s how they translate into what we’re looking for in this role:

  • Customer First: You start by understanding the people using the product, run thoughtful research, and use what you learn to shape better experiences.

  • Take Ownership: You take responsibility for your features, follow through on the details, and care about the quality of what ships.

  • Enable Autonomy: You communicate clearly, collaborate early, and give Product and Engineering the context they need to make strong decisions together.

  • Under Promise, Over Deliver: You set realistic expectations, think through the details, and deliver complete, production-ready work.

  • Innovate & Deliver Value Quickly: You’re comfortable experimenting, using AI and other tools thoughtfully, and moving quickly without sacrificing sound product judgment.

About the Team

Endear’s product organization is structured across three product teams: AI, IRL, and Core Flows, with one designer dedicated to each.

As the IRL designer, you’ll work closely with a Product Manager and 2–3 Engineers while also being part of Endear’s three-person design team. You’ll report to the Head of Product Design, who will provide vision, direction, mentorship, and support as you grow in the role.

You’ll partner most closely with:

  • Head of Product Design: vision, direction, mentorship, feedback, and design leadership

  • Product Team: roadmap alignment, priorities, customer needs, and business context

  • Engineering Team: feasibility, implementation, and iteration

You’ll have access to mentorship, an education budget, and support around Endear’s AI processes to help you continue developing your craft and expanding how you use AI in your work.

We’re a small team with big ambitions — collaborative, customer-obsessed, and deeply excited about the problems we’re solving in retail.

Our Hiring Process

  1. Recruiter Screen

  2. Behavioral Interview with the Hiring Manager

  3. Team Portfolio Review with Design, Product + Engineering

  4. Final leadership conversation

  5. Offer 🎉

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Salary: $100K–$129K

  • Fully remote, US-based team

  • Comprehensive healthcare (medical, dental, vision)

  • Co-working or home office stipend

  • Flexible PTO and unlimited vacation

  • Education and learning support

  • Opportunity to shape foundational product work in a transformative industry

Location: This role is remote and US-based. Our full team comes together for an all-team standup every Monday at 8:00 AM Pacific, so you’ll need to be available at that time.

Apply Even If You Don’t Check Every Box

If this role excites you but you’re unsure if you meet every requirement, reach out anyway. No retail or e-commerce background is required. We care about your product thinking, skills, motivation, and how you approach problems more than we do about perfect resumes.

jobs.title: Closer
jobs.description:
Chez nous, vendre, c'est coacher à la décision. 🎯

Nous sommes convaincus de trois choses :

  • Vous êtes là pour sincèrement aider la personne en face de vous.

  • Sa réussite se trouve souvent en dehors de sa zone de confort.

  • Pour obtenir des résultats différents, il faut oser faire les choses différemment.

Cela implique parfois de confronter les prospects à leurs peurs, leurs contradictions ou leurs croyances limitantes.

Même si c'est inconfortable. 💡

Parfois, votre rôle sera simplement de provoquer une prise de conscience et de les laisser partir. D'autres fois, il faudra aller plus loin pour les aider à regarder la réalité en face.

Toujours avec la même intention : faire ce qui est le mieux pour eux.

Si cette façon de voir la vente vous parle, lisez la suite. 👇

À propos de NextGenLearning 🚀

Chez NextGenLearning, nous accompagnons des personnes qui partent de zéro pour se reconvertir en Data Analyst et décrocher un emploi.

Notre objectif n’est pas de faire une formation de plus, mais de développer un nouveau standard dans notre domaine.

Nous avons construit un produit exceptionnel, qui permet à nos élèves d'obtenir des transformations que beaucoup pensent impossibles.

Et plutôt que de vous demander de nous croire sur parole, voici quelques témoignages de nos élèves : 🎥

  • Barman → Data Analyst : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yTFLTspkOGc

  • BAC+2 → Data Analyst : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jkiycuwroAo

  • Fonctionnaire → Data Analyst (en 8 mois avec famille et boulot en // ) : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oTGsn3x391Y

  • Marketing → Data Project Manager : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lQG_-yspImU

  • Jonathan - Retour après avoir fait des bootcamps pendant 4 ans : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qZqLoWP1RwA

Nous sommes une petite équipe de passionnés, curieux, exigeants avec nous-mêmes, qui aiment le travail bien fait et cherchent constamment à s'améliorer.

Nous grandissons et aujourd’hui, nous recherchons un Closer qui souhaite construire avec nous sur le long terme.

Votre mission 🤝

Nos prospects prennent une décision importante : changer de métier.

Votre rôle est de comprendre leur situation, de leur apporter les connaissances et les perspectives nécessaires, et de les aider à prendre une décision éclairée.

Cela demande de savoir écouter, expliquer, rassurer et parfois confronter leurs idées.

Concrètement :

  • Mener des entretiens de vente avec des prospects qualifiés.

  • Comprendre leurs motivations, leurs freins et leurs objectifs.

  • Présenter notre accompagnement avec pédagogie.

  • Assurer le suivi commercial et le reporting quotidien.

  • Respect de nos process : les leads qualifiés le sont.

  • Participer aux trainings d’équipe pour progresser continuellement.

Conditions 📋

  • Statut : Freelance / Indépendant

  • Lieu : 100% télétravail, d'où vous voulez 🌎

  • Disponibilité : minimum 15h par semaine, dont 10h de calls commerciaux

  • Rémunération : discutée après qualification de votre candidature.


Ce qui compte pour nous, ce sont les résultats, pas les heures travaillées.

Vous êtes libre de vous organiser comme vous le souhaitez. En contrepartie, nous attendons de la fiabilité : tenir vos engagements et être présent dans les moments importants.

Nous voulons être les meilleurs et gagner, mais jamais au détriment de notre santé, de notre famille ou de notre vie personnelle.

Le profil recherché 🌟

  • Amoureux de la psychologie humaine : vous aimez comprendre les gens, leurs motivations, leurs peurs et leurs comportements.

  • Intelligence émotionnelle : vous savez écouter, faire preuve d'empathie et confronter avec bienveillance.

  • Communication : vous vous exprimez avec clarté, précision et impact.

  • Ouvert au feedback (essentiel) : vous aimez apprendre, remettre en question vos méthodes et progresser.

  • Autonome et fiable : vous savez vous organiser et prendre vos responsabilités.

  • Orienté résultats

Une expérience en vente, accompagnement client ou marketing est un plus.

Mais ce sont avant tout vos compétences démontrées qui nous intéressent, pas vos diplômes ou certifications.

🚀 Pourquoi rejoindre l’équipe

  • La meilleure raison de travailler avec nous, c’est que vous aimez ce que nous faisons et vous avez envie d’en faire partie, surtout si notre mission vous inspire.

  • Vous travaillez d’où bon vous semble.

  • Si vous êtes performant, vous prendrez rapidement en responsabilité au sein de l’entreprise. Nous verrons ensemble comment vous propulser vers vos objectifs et aller bien plus loin que ça (du moment que vous avez l'ambition et la détermination d'avancer avec nous sur ce chemin) !

Pour postuler ✉️

Envoyez-nous votre candidature accompagnée d'une courte vidéo (2-5 minutes) dans laquelle vous présentez :

  • Votre parcours et vos expériences commerciales.

  • Vos résultats et vos principales forces.

  • Pourquoi vous souhaitez rejoindre NextGenLearning.

Si votre profil retient notre attention, nous vous recontacterons pour un premier échange.

jobs.title: Account Development Representative - United States
jobs.description:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the Role:

Hi there! We're hiring an ADR I to join our Account Development team at Camunda.

We're a tight-knit, energetic team that takes outbound seriously without taking ourselves too seriously. We run structured prospecting motions, share what's working in real time, celebrate the wins together, and still allow for flexibility in the way we operate because booking a good meeting takes real work and progressing an opportunity puts ADRs at the forefront of a great GTM motion.

This is a strong entry point into tech sales for someone who wants to learn and refine the fundamentals of prospecting, discovery, and pipeline generation inside an enterprise software motion. You'll work directly with Account Executives but will also be responsible for prospecting into your own patch. We ask that all of our ADRs have a remote environment that is conducive to consistent weekly motions and to be able to travel 4-6 times per year, usually a week or less at a time.

As an ADR I, you'll run long-term outbound and timely inbound prospecting motions to generate qualified pipeline for our sales team. Working emails, sales cadences, social outreach and most importantly calls to get in front of the right people at the right accounts at the right time. This role exists because a sustainable pipeline is built through persistence, consistency, a growth mindset and an ability to diagnose challenges and bring solutions within your own prospecting motion.

What you'll be doing:

  • Generate qualified pipeline by running outbound prospecting across email, phone, event outreach and attendance and LinkedIn into target accounts.

  • Qualify inbound interest through ADR-led scheduled calls and convert into booked meetings for Account Executives.

  • Research accounts, personas and signals to tailor and leverage AI for high touch low impact motions.

  • Partner with Account Executives to understand what constitutes a quality meeting, contact and account, and adjust your approach based on feedback.

  • Exhibit excellent operational hygiene by tracking activity and pipeline health in Salesforce and other sales tools to monitor your own inputs and performance.

  • Learn Camunda's product and value propositions and the process orchestration space well enough to have credible, useful conversations with prospects in specific verticals.

What you bring:

  • Some experience with outbound prospecting or customer-facing communication is preferred. This doesn't have to be in sales. Internships, retail, hospitality, or customer support all count if you know how to build rapport with people, manage expectations and handle rejection.

  • Comfort with strict time management and prioritization of requests. You'll be conducting a lot of calls and emails, and you're motivated by the math of it. You will also be given regular enablement and will be responsible for monitoring multiple sources of leads.

  • Curiosity about technology and a willingness to learn a technical product. You don't need an engineering background, but you need to be genuinely interested in understanding what Camunda does and why it matters to the people you're calling. You share successes.

  • Resilience and self-awareness. You know how to keep going without getting discouraged, and you can tell the difference between a bad day and a bad approach.

  • Coachability. You take feedback from your manager and AEs seriously and change your approach in a timely and meaningful way based on it.

  • Cross-functional relationships. You have a curiosity as to how things work and which individuals you can support and thus that can support you. You ask questions and challenge the status quo if you’ve experienced a better solution.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Ability and/or willingness to use our product.

What We Have to Offer:

Compensation

We offer fair, transparent, and competitive compensation. For new hires, we typically place candidates in the first half of the range, allowing room for growth over time.

Annual Total Cash (base salary + 100% variable, where applicable):

  • United States: $91,000 to $181,700

  • Germany: €58,800 to €120,500

Equity: We also offer equity (where applicable) through our Virtual Stock Option Plan (VSOP).

Benefits & Perks

We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable.

  • Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it.

  • In Person Connection: We invest in meaningful face time through our Annual Kickoff (Vienna in 2025, Madrid in 2026!), team offsites, and Camundi Connection Budgets, including contributing to meetups while travelling,, and local gatherings with fellow Camundi.

  • Health & Wellbeing: Access locally tailored healthcare, Modern Health for global mental wellbeing, and our Live Well Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA), a flexible, global benefit that puts you in control of your whole life, not just work, from: staying active, to caring for family, exploring personal passions, meaningful experiences, and investing in your financial wellbeing. The Live Well program launches in 2026 and scales to €1,000 annually from 2027.

  • Financial Security: Retirement and pension plans (often with company contributions), plus life and disability insurance where relevant.

  • Professional Growth: Up to $/€/£1,000 per year for self-driven learning: courses, certifications, books, you decide!

AI in our hiring process: Camunda may use AI tools to aid the screening of applications and during the interview process. You can learn more here

”Everyone is welcome at Camunda” — it’s a celebrated component of our culture. We strive to create an inclusive environment that empowers our people. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, religion, belief, sexual orientation, age, disability or any other protected characteristics under applicable law. We are looking forward to your application!

jobs.title: Stage de Master 2 : Comprendre les transformations structurales des hydrates de sels inorganiques pour le stockage d’énergie thermochimique - 5 à 6 mois
